title: DualCoT-VLA: Visual-Linguistic Chain of Thought via Parallel Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robotic actions. While effective for simple tasks, standard VLA models often struggle with complex, multi-step tasks requiring logical planning, as well as precise manipulations demanding fine-grained spatial perception. Recent efforts have incorporated Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to endow VLA models with a ``thinking before acting'' capability. However, current CoT-based VLA models face two critical limitations: 1) an inability to simultaneously capture low-level visual details and high-level logical planning due to their reliance on isolated, single-modal CoT; 2) high inference latency with compounding errors caused by step-by-step autoregressive decoding. To address these limitations, we propose DualCoT-VLA, a visual-linguistic CoT method for VLA models with a parallel reasoning mechanism. To achieve comprehensive multi-modal reasoning, our method integrates a visual CoT for low-level spatial understanding and a linguistic CoT for high-level task planning. Furthermore, to overcome the latency bottleneck, we introduce a parallel CoT mechanism that incorporates two sets of learnable query tokens, shifting autoregressive reasoning to single-step forward reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our DualCoT-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboCasa GR1 benchmarks, as well as in real-world platforms.
tldr: The paper introduces DualCoT-VLA, a novel Visual-Linguistic Chain-of-Thought method for Vision-Language-Action models that uses parallel reasoning through visual and linguistic CoTs to address limitations related to simultaneous low-level and high-level reasoning and inference latency in complex robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 这篇论文介绍了 DualCoT-VLA，一种用于视觉-语言-动作模型的新型视觉-语言思维链方法，它通过视觉和语言思维链使用并行推理，以解决复杂机器人任务中与同步低级和高级推理以及推理延迟相关的限制。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观测和语言指令直接映射到机器人动作。尽管对于简单任务有效，但标准VLA模型通常难以处理需要逻辑规划的复杂、多步骤任务，以及需要精细空间感知的精确操作。最近的研究已经结合了思维链（CoT）推理，赋予VLA模型“先思考后行动”的能力。然而，目前基于CoT的VLA模型面临两个关键限制：1) 因为依赖于孤立的、单模态的CoT，无法同时捕获低层次的视觉细节和高层次的逻辑规划；2) 由于逐步自回归解码导致的高推理延迟和累积误差。为了解决这些限制，我们提出DualCoT-VLA，一种具有并行推理机制的VLA模型的视觉-语言CoT方法。为了实现全面的多模态推理，我们的方法集成了用于低层次空间理解的视觉CoT和用于高层次任务规划的语言CoT。此外，为了克服延迟瓶颈，我们引入了一种并行CoT机制，该机制包含两组可学习的查询令牌，将自回归推理转变为单步前向推理。大量实验表明，我们的DualCoT-VLA在LIBERO和RoboCasa GR1基准测试以及真实世界平台上都实现了最先进的性能。

title: VP-VLA: Visual Prompting as an Interface for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically map visual observations and linguistic instructions directly to robotic control signals. This "black-box" mapping forces a single forward pass to simultaneously handle instruction interpretation, spatial grounding, and low-level control, often leading to poor spatial precision and limited robustness in out-of-distribution scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose VP-VLA, a dual-system framework that decouples high-level reasoning and low-level execution via a structured visual prompting interface. Specifically, a "System 2 Planner" decomposes complex instructions into sub-tasks and identifies relevant target objects and goal locations. These spatial anchors are then overlaid directly onto visual observations as structured visual prompts, such as crosshairs and bounding boxes. Guided by these prompts and enhanced by a novel auxiliary visual grounding objective during training, a "System 1 Controller" reliably generates precise low-level execution motions. Experiments on the Robocasa-GR1-Tabletop benchmark and SimplerEnv simulation demonstrate that VP-VLA improves success rates by 5% and 8.3%, surpassing competitive baselines including QwenOFT and GR00T-N1.6.
tldr: The paper introduces VP-VLA, a dual-system VLA framework that uses visual prompting to decouple high-level reasoning and low-level control, improving precision and robustness in robotic tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种双系统VLA框架VP-VLA，它使用视觉提示来解耦高层推理和低层控制，从而提高机器人任务的精度和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常直接将视觉观测和语言指令映射到机器人控制信号。这种“黑盒”映射迫使单一前向传递同时处理指令理解、空间定位和底层控制，常常导致较差的空间精度以及在分布外场景中有限的鲁棒性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了VP-VLA，一种双系统框架，通过结构化的视觉提示接口解耦高层推理和底层执行。具体而言，“系统2规划器”将复杂指令分解为子任务，并识别相关的目标对象和目标位置。然后将这些空间锚点作为结构化的视觉提示，例如十字线和边界框，直接叠加到视觉观测上。在这些提示的引导下，并通过训练期间的新型辅助视觉定位目标增强，“系统1控制器”能够可靠地生成精确的底层执行动作。在Robocasa-GR1-Tabletop基准测试和SimplerEnv模拟上的实验表明，VP-VLA将成功率提高了5%和8.3%，超过了具有竞争力的基线模型，包括QwenOFT和GR00T-N1.6。

title: UniMotion: A Unified Framework for Motion-Text-Vision Understanding and Generation
summary: We present UniMotion, to our knowledge the first unified framework for simultaneous understanding and generation of human motion, natural language, and RGB images within a single architecture. Existing unified models handle only restricted modality subsets (e.g., Motion-Text or static Pose-Image) and predominantly rely on discrete tokenization, which introduces quantization errors and disrupts temporal continuity. UniMotion overcomes both limitations through a core principle: treating motion as a first-class continuous modality on equal footing with RGB. A novel Cross-Modal Aligned Motion VAE (CMA-VAE) and symmetric dual-path embedders construct parallel continuous pathways for Motion and RGB within a shared LLM backbone. To inject visual-semantic priors into motion representations without requiring images at inference, we propose Dual-Posterior KL Alignment (DPA), which distills a vision-fused encoder's richer posterior into the motion-only encoder. To address the cold-start problem -- where text supervision alone is too sparse to calibrate the newly introduced motion pathway -- we further propose Latent Reconstruction Alignment (LRA), a self-supervised pre-training strategy that uses dense motion latents as unambiguous conditions to co-calibrate the embedder, backbone, and flow head, establishing a stable motion-aware foundation for all downstream tasks. UniMotion achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven tasks spanning any-to-any understanding, generation, and editing among the three modalities, with especially strong advantages on cross-modal compositional tasks.
tldr: UniMotion is a novel unified framework for understanding and generating human motion, text, and images. It introduces continuous motion representation and achieves state-of-the-art performance across various cross-modal tasks.
tldr_zh: UniMotion是一个新颖的统一框架，用于理解和生成人体运动、文本和图像。 它引入了连续运动表示，并在各种跨模态任务中实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 我们提出了 UniMotion，据我们所知，这是第一个在单一架构内同时进行人体动作、自然语言和 RGB 图像理解和生成的统一框架。现有的统一模型仅能处理受限的模态子集（例如，动作-文本或静态姿态-图像），并且主要依赖于离散分词，这会引入量化误差并破坏时间连续性。UniMotion 通过一个核心原则克服了这两个限制：将动作视为与 RGB 同等重要的首要连续模态。一种新颖的跨模态对齐动作 VAE (CMA-VAE) 和对称双路径嵌入器在共享的 LLM 主干网络中构建了动作和 RGB 的并行连续通路。为了在推理时无需图像即可将视觉语义先验注入到动作表示中，我们提出了双后验 KL 对齐 (DPA)，它将视觉融合编码器更丰富的后验概率分布提炼到仅动作编码器中。为了解决冷启动问题——即仅靠文本监督不足以校准新引入的动作通路——我们进一步提出了潜在重构对齐 (LRA)，这是一种自监督预训练策略，它使用密集的动作潜在变量作为明确的条件，以协同校准嵌入器、主干网络和流动头，从而为所有下游任务建立一个稳定的动作感知基础。UniMotion 在涵盖三种模态之间任意到任意的理解、生成和编辑的七个任务中实现了最先进的性能，尤其是在跨模态组合任务上表现出强大的优势。

title: PivotRL: High Accuracy Agentic Post-Training at Low Compute Cost
summary: Post-training for long-horizon agentic tasks has a tension between compute efficiency and generalization. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is compute efficient, it often suffers from out-of-domain (OOD) degradation. Conversely, end-to-end reinforcement learning (E2E RL) preserves OOD capabilities, but incurs high compute costs due to many turns of on-policy rollout. We introduce PivotRL, a novel framework that operates on existing SFT trajectories to combine the compute efficiency of SFT with the OOD accuracy of E2E RL. PivotRL relies on two key mechanisms: first, it executes local, on-policy rollouts and filters for pivots: informative intermediate turns where sampled actions exhibit high variance in outcomes; second, it utilizes rewards for functional-equivalent actions rather than demanding strict string matching with the SFT data demonstration. We theoretically show that these mechanisms incentivize strong learning signals with high natural gradient norm, while maximally preserving policy probability ordering on actions unrelated to training tasks. In comparison to standard SFT on identical data, we demonstrate that PivotRL achieves +4.17% higher in-domain accuracy on average across four agentic domains, and +10.04% higher OOD accuracy in non-agentic tasks. Notably, on agentic coding tasks, PivotRL achieves competitive accuracy with E2E RL with 4x fewer rollout turns. PivotRL is adopted by NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B, acting as the workhorse in production-scale agentic post-training.
tldr: PivotRL combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning by focusing on informative intermediate actions (pivots) and utilizing reward-based learning, achieving improved accuracy and efficiency in agentic tasks. It has even been adopted by NVIDIA in production.
tldr_zh: PivotRL结合了监督微调和强化学习，通过关注信息丰富的中间动作（关键点）并利用基于奖励的学习，在代理任务中提高了准确性和效率，已被NVIDIA生产采用。
summary_zh: 长时程智能体任务的后训练面临计算效率和泛化性之间的权衡。虽然有监督微调（SFT）在计算上高效，但常会遭受领域外（OOD）退化。相反，端到端强化学习（E2E RL）可以保持OOD能力，但由于需要多次在线策略 rollout，会产生高昂的计算成本。我们提出了PivotRL，一个新颖的框架，它基于现有的SFT轨迹运行，将SFT的计算效率与E2E RL的OOD准确性相结合。PivotRL依赖于两个关键机制：首先，它执行局部的在线策略rollout，并筛选出枢纽点：信息量丰富的中途节点，其中采样的动作在结果上表现出高方差；其次，它利用功能等价动作的奖励，而不是要求与SFT数据演示进行严格的字符串匹配。我们在理论上表明，这些机制激励了具有高自然梯度范数的强学习信号，同时最大程度地保留了策略在与训练任务无关的动作上的概率排序。与在相同数据上进行标准SFT相比，我们证明了PivotRL在四个智能体领域平均实现了+4.17%的更高领域内准确率，以及在非智能体任务中实现了+10.04%的更高OOD准确率。值得注意的是，在智能体编码任务上，PivotRL以少4倍的rollout次数实现了与E2E RL相当的准确率。PivotRL已被NVIDIA的Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B采用，作为生产规模智能体后训练的工作主力。

title: AdaRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for LLM Agent Evaluation
summary: LLM-as-Judge evaluation fails agent tasks because a fixed rubric cannot capture what matters for this task: code debugging demands Correctness and Error Handling; web navigation demands Goal Alignment and Action Efficiency. We present ADARUBRIC, which closes this gap by generating task-specific evaluation rubrics on the fly from task descriptions, scoring trajectories step-by-step with confidence-weighted per-dimension feedback, and filtering preference pairs with the novel DimensionAwareFilter - a provably necessary condition for preventing high-scoring dimensions from masking dimension-level failures. On WebArena and ToolBench, ADARUBRIC achieves Pearson r=0.79 human correlation (+0.16 over the best static baseline) with deployment-grade reliability (Krippendorff's $α$=0.83). DPO agents trained on ADARUBRIC preference pairs gain +6.8 to +8.5 pp task success over Prometheus across three benchmarks; gains transfer to SWE-bench code repair (+4.9 pp) and accelerate PPO convergence by +6.6 pp at 5K steps - both without any rubric engineering. Code: https://github.com/alphadl/AdaRubrics.
tldr: The paper introduces AdaRubric, a method for generating task-specific LLM evaluation rubrics on the fly. It shows improved correlation with human judgment and boosts agent performance on downstream tasks like code repair and PPO convergence.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了AdaRubric，一种用于即时生成特定任务的LLM评估标准的方法。它显示了与人类判断的更高相关性，并提高了代理在下游任务（如代码修复和PPO收敛）上的性能。
summary_zh: LLM-即服务作为评判者的评估方法在智能体任务中失败，原因是固定的评分标准无法捕捉该任务的关键要素：代码调试需要正确性和错误处理；网页导航需要目标对齐和行动效率。我们提出了ADARUBRIC，它通过以下方式弥补了这一差距：根据任务描述动态生成特定于任务的评估标准，使用置信度加权的维度反馈逐步对轨迹进行评分，并使用新型的维度感知过滤器（DimensionAwareFilter）过滤偏好对，该过滤器是防止高分维度掩盖维度层面失败的充分必要条件。在WebArena和ToolBench上，ADARUBRIC实现了Pearson相关系数r=0.79的人工相关性（比最佳静态基线高+0.16），并具有部署级别的可靠性（Krippendorff's $α$=0.83）。在ADARUBRIC偏好对上训练的DPO智能体在三个基准测试中，任务成功率比Prometheus高+6.8到+8.5个百分点；收益转移到SWE-bench代码修复（+4.9个百分点），并在5K步时加速PPO收敛+6.6个百分点 - 所有这些都无需任何评分标准工程。代码：https://github.com/alphadl/AdaRubrics。

title: Omni-WorldBench: Towards a Comprehensive Interaction-Centric Evaluation for World Models
summary: Video--based world models have emerged along two dominant paradigms: video generation and 3D reconstruction. However, existing evaluation benchmarks either focus narrowly on visual fidelity and text--video alignment for generative models, or rely on static 3D reconstruction metrics that fundamentally neglect temporal dynamics. We argue that the future of world modeling lies in 4D generation, which jointly models spatial structure and temporal evolution. In this paradigm, the core capability is interactive response: the ability to faithfully reflect how interaction actions drive state transitions across space and time. Yet no existing benchmark systematically evaluates this critical dimension. To address this gap, we propose Omni--WorldBench, a comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the interactive response capabilities of world models in 4D settings. Omni--WorldBench comprises two key components: Omni--WorldSuite, a systematic prompt suite spanning diverse interaction levels and scene types; and Omni--Metrics, an agent-based evaluation framework that quantifies world modeling capabilities by measuring the causal impact of interaction actions on both final outcomes and intermediate state evolution trajectories. We conduct extensive evaluations of 18 representative world models across multiple paradigms. Our analysis reveals critical limitations of current world models in interactive response, providing actionable insights for future research. Omni-WorldBench will be publicly released to foster progress in interactive 4D world modeling.
tldr: The paper introduces Omni-WorldBench, a new benchmark to evaluate the interactive response capabilities of world models in 4D settings, highlighting current models' limitations and providing a tool for future research.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Omni-WorldBench，一个新的基准测试，用于评估世界模型在4D环境中的交互响应能力，强调了当前模型的局限性，并为未来的研究提供了一个工具。
summary_zh: 基于视频的世界模型已经出现了两种主要的范式：视频生成和 3D 重建。 然而，现有的评估基准要么狭隘地关注生成模型的视觉保真度和文本-视频对齐，要么依赖于静态的 3D 重建指标，而这从根本上忽略了时间动态。 我们认为，世界模型的未来在于 4D 生成，即联合建模空间结构和时间演变。 在这种范式中，核心能力是交互式响应：能够忠实地反映交互动作如何驱动跨越空间和时间的状态转换。 然而，没有现有的基准系统地评估这个关键维度。 为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 Omni-WorldBench，一个全面设计的基准，专门用于评估世界模型在 4D 环境中的交互式响应能力。 Omni-WorldBench 包含两个关键组成部分：Omni-WorldSuite，一个系统性的提示套件，涵盖不同的交互水平和场景类型； 以及 Omni-Metrics，一个基于代理的评估框架，通过测量交互动作对最终结果和中间状态演化轨迹的因果影响来量化世界建模能力。 我们对多个范式中的 18 个代表性世界模型进行了广泛的评估。 我们的分析揭示了当前世界模型在交互式响应方面的关键局限性，为未来的研究提供了可操作的见解。 Omni-WorldBench 将公开发布，以促进交互式 4D 世界建模的进步。

title: Decoupling Exploration and Policy Optimization: Uncertainty Guided Tree Search for Hard Exploration
summary: The process of discovery requires active exploration -- the act of collecting new and informative data. However, efficient autonomous exploration remains a major unsolved problem. The dominant paradigm addresses this challenge by using Reinforcement Learning (RL) to train agents with intrinsic motivation, maximizing a composite objective of extrinsic and intrinsic rewards. We suggest that this approach incurs unnecessary overhead: while policy optimization is necessary for precise task execution, employing such machinery solely to expand state coverage may be inefficient. In this paper, we propose a new paradigm that explicitly separates exploration from exploitation and bypasses RL during the exploration phase. Our method uses a tree-search strategy inspired by the Go-With-The-Winner algorithm, paired with a measure of epistemic uncertainty to systematically drive exploration. By removing the overhead of policy optimization, our approach explores an order of magnitude more efficiently than standard intrinsic motivation baselines on hard Atari benchmarks. Further, we demonstrate that the discovered trajectories can be distilled into deployable policies using existing supervised backward learning algorithms, achieving state-of-the-art scores by a wide margin on Montezuma's Revenge, Pitfall!, and Venture without relying on domain-specific knowledge. Finally, we demonstrate the generality of our framework in high-dimensional continuous action spaces by solving the MuJoCo Adroit dexterous manipulation and AntMaze tasks in a sparse-reward setting, directly from image observations and without expert demonstrations or offline datasets. To the best of our knowledge, this has not been achieved before.
tldr: This paper introduces a novel exploration method that decouples exploration from policy optimization using uncertainty-guided tree search, achieving significant performance gains on hard exploration tasks compared to intrinsic motivation baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的探索方法，将探索与策略优化分离，采用不确定性引导的树搜索，在困难探索任务上比内在激励基线实现了显著的性能提升。
summary_zh: 发现过程需要积极探索——即收集新的、信息量大的数据。然而，高效的自主探索仍然是一个尚未解决的主要问题。主流范式通过使用强化学习（RL）训练具有内在动机的智能体来应对这一挑战，从而最大化外在和内在奖励的复合目标。我们认为这种方法会产生不必要的开销：虽然策略优化对于精确的任务执行是必要的，但仅仅为了扩大状态覆盖范围而采用这种机制可能效率低下。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的范式，它将探索与利用明确分离，并在探索阶段绕过强化学习。我们的方法使用一种受 Go-With-The-Winner 算法启发的树搜索策略，并结合认知不确定性的度量来系统地驱动探索。通过消除策略优化的开销，我们的方法在具有挑战性的 Atari 基准测试中，比标准的内在动机基线高效一个数量级。此外，我们证明，可以使用现有的监督反向学习算法将发现的轨迹提炼成可部署的策略，从而在不依赖领域特定知识的情况下，在 Montezuma's Revenge、Pitfall! 和 Venture 上获得大幅领先的最新分数。最后，我们展示了我们的框架在高维连续动作空间中的通用性，通过仅从图像观察且无需专家演示或离线数据集，在稀疏奖励环境下解决了 MuJoCo Adroit 灵巧操纵和 AntMaze 任务。据我们所知，这以前从未实现过。

title: ThinkJEPA: Empowering Latent World Models with Large Vision-Language Reasoning Model
summary: Recent progress in latent world models (e.g., V-JEPA2) has shown promising capability in forecasting future world states from video observations. Nevertheless, dense prediction from a short observation window limits temporal context and can bias predictors toward local, low-level extrapolation, making it difficult to capture long-horizon semantics and reducing downstream utility. Vision--language models (VLMs), in contrast, provide strong semantic grounding and general knowledge by reasoning over uniformly sampled frames, but they are not ideal as standalone dense predictors due to compute-driven sparse sampling, a language-output bottleneck that compresses fine-grained interaction states into text-oriented representations, and a data-regime mismatch when adapting to small action-conditioned datasets. We propose a VLM-guided JEPA-style latent world modeling framework that combines dense-frame dynamics modeling with long-horizon semantic guidance via a dual-temporal pathway: a dense JEPA branch for fine-grained motion and interaction cues, and a uniformly sampled VLM \emph{thinker} branch with a larger temporal stride for knowledge-rich guidance. To transfer the VLM's progressive reasoning signals effectively, we introduce a hierarchical pyramid representation extraction module that aggregates multi-layer VLM representations into guidance features compatible with latent prediction. Experiments on hand-manipulation trajectory prediction show that our method outperforms both a strong VLM-only baseline and a JEPA-predictor baseline, and yields more robust long-horizon rollout behavior.
tldr: This paper introduces ThinkJEPA, a VLM-guided JEPA-style latent world model that combines dense-frame dynamics modeling with long-horizon semantic guidance to improve long-horizon rollout behavior in hand-manipulation trajectory prediction.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了ThinkJEPA，一种以VLM为指导的JEPA风格的潜在世界模型，它结合了密集帧动态建模和长程语义指导，以提高手部操作轨迹预测中的长程展开行为。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型（例如，V-JEPA2）的最新进展已经展示了从视频观测中预测未来世界状态的良好能力。然而，从短观测窗口进行密集预测限制了时间上下文，并且可能使预测器偏向局部、低级别的外推，从而难以捕捉长时程语义并降低下游效用。相比之下，视觉-语言模型（VLMs）通过对均匀采样的帧进行推理，提供了强大的语义基础和通用知识，但由于计算驱动的稀疏采样、将细粒度交互状态压缩成面向文本的表示的语言输出瓶颈，以及适应于小型动作条件数据集时的数据态势不匹配等原因，它们作为独立的密集预测器并不理想。我们提出了一种VLM引导的JEPA风格潜在世界建模框架，该框架通过双时间路径将密集帧动态建模与长时程语义引导相结合：一个用于精细运动和交互线索的密集JEPA分支，以及一个具有更大时间步长的均匀采样VLM“思考者”分支，用于提供知识丰富的指导。为了有效地传递VLM的渐进推理信号，我们引入了一个分层金字塔表示提取模块，该模块将多层VLM表示聚合为与潜在预测兼容的指导特征。在手工操作轨迹预测上的实验表明，我们的方法优于强大的纯VLM基线和JEPA预测器基线，并产生了更稳健的长时程展开行为。

title: UniDex: A Robot Foundation Suite for Universal Dexterous Hand Control from Egocentric Human Videos
summary: Dexterous manipulation remains challenging due to the cost of collecting real-robot teleoperation data, the heterogeneity of hand embodiments, and the high dimensionality of control. We present UniDex, a robot foundation suite that couples a large-scale robot-centric dataset with a unified vision-language-action (VLA) policy and a practical human-data capture setup for universal dexterous hand control. First, we construct UniDex-Dataset, a robot-centric dataset over 50K trajectories across eight dexterous hands (6--24 DoFs), derived from egocentric human video datasets. To transform human data into robot-executable trajectories, we employ a human-in-the-loop retargeting procedure to align fingertip trajectories while preserving plausible hand-object contacts, and we operate on explicit 3D pointclouds with human hands masked to narrow kinematic and visual gaps. Second, we introduce the Function-Actuator-Aligned Space (FAAS), a unified action space that maps functionally similar actuators to shared coordinates, enabling cross-hand transfer. Leveraging FAAS as the action parameterization, we train UniDex-VLA, a 3D VLA policy pretrained on UniDex-Dataset and finetuned with task demonstrations. In addition, we build UniDex-Cap, a simple portable capture setup that records synchronized RGB-D streams and human hand poses and converts them into robot-executable trajectories to enable human-robot data co-training that reduces reliance on costly robot demonstrations. On challenging tool-use tasks across two different hands, UniDex-VLA achieves 81% average task progress and outperforms prior VLA baselines by a large margin, while exhibiting strong spatial, object, and zero-shot cross-hand generalization. Together, UniDex-Dataset, UniDex-VLA, and UniDex-Cap provide a scalable foundation suite for universal dexterous manipulation.
tldr: The paper introduces UniDex, a robot foundation suite for universal dexterous hand control using a large-scale robot-centric dataset derived from egocentric human videos, a unified vision-language-action policy, and a practical human-data capture setup, demonstrating strong generalization capabilities on tool-use tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了UniDex，一个用于通用灵巧手控制的机器人基础套件，它使用从以自我为中心的人类视频中获取的大规模机器人中心数据集、统一的视觉-语言-动作策略和实用的人类数据捕获设置，并在工具使用任务中表现出强大的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 灵巧操作仍然充满挑战，原因在于收集真实机器人遥操作数据的成本高昂、手部形态各异以及控制维度过高。我们提出了UniDex，一个机器人基础套件，它将大规模机器人中心数据集、统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略和实用的人类数据捕获装置相结合，用于通用灵巧手控制。首先，我们构建了UniDex-Dataset，一个机器人中心数据集，包含来自以人为中心的视频数据集的跨越八种灵巧手（6-24个自由度）的超过5万条轨迹。为了将人类数据转换为机器人可执行的轨迹，我们采用一种人机协同重定向程序，在保留合理的手-物接触的同时对齐指尖轨迹，并操作显式的3D点云（其中人类手部被遮罩），以缩小运动和视觉差异。其次，我们引入了功能-执行器对齐空间(FAAS)，一个统一的动作空间，它将功能相似的执行器映射到共享坐标，从而实现跨手转移。利用FAAS作为动作参数化，我们训练了UniDex-VLA，一个基于UniDex-Dataset预训练并使用任务演示进行微调的3D VLA策略。此外，我们构建了UniDex-Cap，一种简单的便携式捕获装置，用于记录同步的RGB-D流和人类手部姿势，并将它们转换为机器人可执行轨迹，从而实现人机数据协同训练，减少对昂贵的机器人演示的依赖。在两个不同手部的具有挑战性的工具使用任务中，UniDex-VLA实现了81%的平均任务进度，并大幅优于之前的VLA基线，同时表现出强大的空间、物体和零样本跨手泛化能力。总而言之，UniDex-Dataset、UniDex-VLA和UniDex-Cap为一个通用的灵巧操作提供了一个可扩展的基础套件。

title: DexDrummer: In-Hand, Contact-Rich, and Long-Horizon Dexterous Robot Drumming
summary: Performing in-hand, contact-rich, and long-horizon dexterous manipulation remains an unsolved challenge in robotics. Prior hand dexterity works have considered each of these three challenges in isolation, yet do not combine these skills into a single, complex task. To further test the capabilities of dexterity, we propose drumming as a testbed for dexterous manipulation. Drumming naturally integrates all three challenges: it involves in-hand control for stabilizing and adjusting the drumstick with the fingers, contact-rich interaction through repeated striking of the drum surface, and long-horizon coordination when switching between drums and sustaining rhythmic play. We present DexDrummer, a hierarchical object-centric bimanual drumming policy trained in simulation with sim-to-real transfer. The framework reduces the exploration difficulty of pure reinforcement learning by combining trajectory planning with residual RL corrections for fast transitions between drums. A dexterous manipulation policy handles contact-rich dynamics, guided by rewards that explicitly model both finger-stick and stick-drum interactions. In simulation, we show our policy can play two styles of music: multi-drum, bimanual songs and challenging, technical exercises that require increased dexterity. Across simulated bimanual tasks, our dexterous, reactive policy outperforms a fixed grasp policy by 1.87x across easy songs and 1.22x across hard songs F1 scores. In real-world tasks, we show song performance across a multi-drum setup. DexDrummer is able to play our training song and its extended version with an F1 score of 1.0.
tldr: The paper introduces DexDrummer, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dexterous robot drumming, demonstrating sim-to-real transfer on complex drumming tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 DexDrummer，一个用于灵巧机器人击鼓的分层强化学习框架，展示了在复杂击鼓任务上的模拟到真实世界的迁移。
summary_zh: 在机器人学中，执行手中的、富含接触的以及长时域的灵巧操作仍然是一个未解决的挑战。之前的灵巧手研究工作分别考虑了这三个挑战，但没有将这些技能整合到一个复杂的任务中。为了进一步测试灵巧操作的能力，我们提出以打鼓作为灵巧操作的试验平台。打鼓自然地整合了所有三个挑战：它涉及用手指稳定和调整鼓槌的手中控制，通过重复敲击鼓面实现的富含接触的交互，以及在鼓之间切换和维持节奏演奏的长时域协调。我们提出了 DexDrummer，一个分层的、以物体为中心的双手动鼓策略，该策略在仿真中训练，并使用仿真到真实的迁移。该框架通过将轨迹规划与残差强化学习校正相结合，以实现鼓之间的快速过渡，从而降低了纯强化学习的探索难度。一个灵巧操作策略处理富含接触的动力学，并由明确建模手指-鼓槌和鼓槌-鼓交互的奖励引导。在仿真中，我们展示了我们的策略可以演奏两种风格的音乐：多鼓的双手歌曲和需要更高灵巧度的具有挑战性的、技术性练习。在模拟的双人任务中，我们的灵巧的、反应性的策略在简单歌曲和困难歌曲的F1得分上分别比固定抓取策略高出1.87倍和1.22倍。在现实世界的任务中，我们展示了在多鼓设置上的歌曲演奏表现。DexDrummer 能够演奏我们的训练歌曲及其扩展版本，F1 得分为 1.0。

title: Cross-Modal Reinforcement Learning for Navigation with Degraded Depth Measurements
summary: This paper presents a cross-modal learning framework that exploits complementary information from depth and grayscale images for robust navigation. We introduce a Cross-Modal Wasserstein Autoencoder that learns shared latent representations by enforcing cross-modal consistency, enabling the system to infer depth-relevant features from grayscale observations when depth measurements are corrupted. The learned representations are integrated with a Reinforcement Learning-based policy for collision-free navigation in unstructured environments when depth sensors experience degradation due to adverse conditions such as poor lighting or reflective surfaces. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that our approach maintains robust performance under significant depth degradation and successfully transfers to real environments.
tldr: This paper introduces a cross-modal reinforcement learning framework using a Wasserstein Autoencoder to enable robust robot navigation under depth sensor degradation by learning to infer depth from grayscale images. It shows improved performance in both simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种跨模态强化学习框架，该框架使用 Wasserstein 自动编码器，通过学习从灰度图像推断深度信息，从而实现在深度传感器退化的情况下实现鲁棒的机器人导航。实验表明，该方法在仿真和现实环境中均能有效提高性能。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种跨模态学习框架，该框架利用深度图像和灰度图像的互补信息来实现稳健导航。我们引入了一种跨模态Wasserstein自编码器，通过强制执行跨模态一致性来学习共享的潜在表示，从而使系统能够在深度测量被破坏时从灰度观测中推断出与深度相关的特征。当深度传感器在恶劣条件下（如光照不足或反射表面）性能下降时，学习到的表示与基于强化学习的策略相结合，用于在非结构化环境中实现无碰撞导航。仿真和真实环境实验表明，我们的方法在显著的深度劣化条件下仍能保持稳健的性能，并能成功迁移到真实环境中。

title: Closed-Loop Verbal Reinforcement Learning for Task-Level Robotic Planning
summary: We propose a new Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) framework for interpretable task-level planning in mobile robotic systems operating under execution uncertainty. The framework follows a closed-loop architecture that enables iterative policy improvement through interaction with the physical environment. In our framework, executable Behavior Trees are repeatedly refined by a Large Language Model actor using structured natural-language feedback produced by a Vision-Language Model critic that observes the physical robot and execution traces. Unlike conventional reinforcement learning, policy updates in VRL occur directly at the symbolic planning level, without gradient-based optimization. This enables transparent reasoning, explicit causal feedback, and human-interpretable policy evolution. We validate the proposed framework on a real mobile robot performing a multi-stage manipulation and navigation task under execution uncertainty. Experimental results show that the framework supports explainable policy improvements, closed-loop adaptation to execution failures, and reliable deployment on physical robotic systems.
tldr: This paper presents a closed-loop Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) framework using LLMs and VLMs for task-level robot planning, demonstrating interpretable policy improvements and adaptation to execution failures on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种闭环的语言强化学习（VRL）框架，利用LLM和VLM进行任务级别的机器人规划，展示了可解释的策略改进和对实际机器人执行失败的适应。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新的语音强化学习（VRL）框架，用于移动机器人系统在执行不确定性下进行的可解释任务级规划。该框架遵循闭环架构，可以通过与物理环境的交互实现迭代策略改进。在我们的框架中，可执行的行为树由大型语言模型执行器重复细化，该执行器使用视觉-语言模型评论器产生的结构化自然语言反馈，该评论器观察物理机器人和执行轨迹。与传统的强化学习不同，VRL中的策略更新直接发生在符号规划层，无需基于梯度的优化。这实现了透明的推理、显式的因果反馈以及人类可解释的策略演化。我们在真实的移动机器人上验证了所提出的框架，该机器人执行多阶段操作和导航任务，并存在执行不确定性。实验结果表明，该框架支持可解释的策略改进、对执行失败的闭环适应以及在物理机器人系统上的可靠部署。

title: ROBOGATE: Adaptive Failure Discovery for Safe Robot Policy Deployment via Two-Stage Boundary-Focused Sampling
summary: Deploying learned robot manipulation policies in industrial settings requires rigorous pre-deployment validation, yet exhaustive testing across high-dimensional parameter spaces is intractable. We present ROBOGATE, a deployment risk management framework that combines physics-based simulation with a two-stage adaptive sampling strategy to efficiently discover failure boundaries in the operational parameter space. Stage 1 employs Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) across an 8-dimensional parameter space to establish a coarse failure landscape from 20,000 uniformly distributed experiments. Stage 2 applies boundary-focused sampling that concentrates 10,000 additional experiments in the 30-70% success rate transition zone, enabling precise failure boundary mapping. Using NVIDIA Isaac Sim with Newton physics, we evaluate a scripted pick-and-place controller on two robot embodiments -- Franka Panda (7-DOF) and UR5e (6-DOF) -- across 30,000 total experiments. Our logistic regression risk model achieves an AUC of 0.780 on the combined dataset (vs. 0.754 for Stage 1 alone), identifies a closed-form failure boundary equation, and reveals four universal danger zones affecting both robot platforms. We further demonstrate the framework on VLA (Vision-Language-Action) model evaluation, where Octo-Small achieves 0.0% success rate on 68 adversarial scenarios versus 100% for the scripted baseline -- a 100-point gap that underscores the challenge of deploying foundation models in industrial settings. ROBOGATE is open-source and runs on a single GPU workstation.
tldr: ROBOGATE is presented, a two-stage adaptive sampling framework for efficient failure discovery and risk management of robot policies in simulation, demonstrating its effectiveness on pick-and-place and vision-language-action model evaluation.
tldr_zh: ROBOGATE是一种两阶段自适应采样框架，用于在仿真中高效地发现机器人策略的故障并进行风险管理。该框架在抓取放置和视觉语言行为模型评估中展示了其有效性。
summary_zh: 在工业环境中部署学习到的机器人操作策略需要严格的预部署验证，然而在高维参数空间中进行详尽的测试是难以实现的。我们提出了 ROBOGATE，一种部署风险管理框架，它结合了基于物理的仿真和两阶段自适应采样策略，以有效地发现操作参数空间中的失效边界。第一阶段采用拉丁超立方采样 (LHS)，在 8 维参数空间中进行 20,000 次均匀分布的实验，以建立粗略的失效图景。第二阶段应用以边界为中心的采样，将额外的 10,000 次实验集中在 30-70% 成功率的过渡区域，从而能够精确地绘制失效边界。我们使用带有牛顿物理引擎的 NVIDIA Isaac Sim，在两种机器人实体上评估一个脚本化的抓取放置控制器——Franka Panda (7 自由度) 和 UR5e (6 自由度)——总共进行了 30,000 次实验。我们的逻辑回归风险模型在组合数据集上实现了 0.780 的 AUC (相比之下，仅第一阶段为 0.754)，识别出一个闭合形式的失效边界方程，并揭示了影响两个机器人平台的四个通用危险区域。我们进一步在 VLA (视觉-语言-行动) 模型评估中演示了该框架，其中 Octo-Small 在 68 个对抗性场景中的成功率为 0.0%，而脚本化基线则为 100%——这 100 个百分点的差距突显了在工业环境中部署基础模型的挑战。ROBOGATE 是开源的，并且可以在单个 GPU 工作站上运行。

title: Do World Action Models Generalize Better than VLAs? A Robustness Study
summary: Robot action planning in the real world is challenging as it requires not only understanding the current state of the environment but also predicting how it will evolve in response to actions. Vision-language-action (VLA), which repurpose large-scale vision-language models for robot action generation using action experts, have achieved notable success across a variety of robotic tasks. Nevertheless, their performance remains constrained by the scope of their training data, exhibiting limited generalization to unseen scenarios and vulnerability to diverse contextual perturbations. More recently, world models have been revisited as an alternative to VLAs. These models, referred to as world action models (WAMs), are built upon world models that are trained on large corpora of video data to predict future states. With minor adaptations, their latent representation can be decoded into robot actions. It has been suggested that their explicit dynamic prediction capacity, combined with spatiotemporal priors acquired from web-scale video pretraining, enables WAMs to generalize more effectively than VLAs. In this paper, we conduct a comparative study of prominent state-of-the-art VLA policies and recently released WAMs. We evaluate their performance on the LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0-Plus benchmarks under various visual and language perturbations. Our results show that WAMs achieve strong robustness, with LingBot-VA reaching 74.2% success rate on RoboTwin 2.0-Plus and Cosmos-Policy achieving 82.2% on LIBERO-Plus. While VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ can achieve comparable robustness on certain tasks, they typically require extensive training with diverse robotic datasets and varied learning objectives. Hybrid approaches that partially incorporate video-based dynamic learning exhibit intermediate robustness, highlighting the importance of how video priors are integrated.
tldr: This paper compares the robustness of World Action Models (WAMs) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in robotic tasks under visual and language perturbations, finding WAMs generally more robust.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了在视觉和语言扰动下，世界行动模型 (WAM) 和视觉-语言-行动模型 (VLA) 在机器人任务中的鲁棒性，发现 WAM 通常更稳健。
summary_zh: 在现实世界中进行机器人动作规划极具挑战性，因为它不仅需要理解环境的当前状态，还需要预测环境将如何响应动作而演变。视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型，它通过利用动作专家将大规模视觉-语言模型重新用于机器人动作生成，已在各种机器人任务中取得了显著成功。然而，它们的性能仍然受到其训练数据范围的限制，表现出对未见场景的泛化能力有限，并且容易受到各种情境扰动的影响。最近，世界模型作为 VLA 的替代方案再次受到关注。这些模型被称为世界动作模型 (WAM)，建立在世界模型之上，这些世界模型在大型视频语料库上进行训练以预测未来的状态。经过少量调整，它们的潜在表示可以被解码为机器人动作。 有人认为，它们显式的动态预测能力，加上从网络规模视频预训练中获得的时空先验，使 WAM 的泛化能力比 VLA 更有效。在本文中，我们对主流的最新 VLA 策略和最近发布的 WAM 进行了对比研究。我们在 LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 2.0-Plus 基准测试中，在各种视觉和语言扰动下评估了它们的性能。我们的结果表明，WAM 实现了强大的鲁棒性，其中 LingBot-VA 在 RoboTwin 2.0-Plus 上的成功率达到 74.2%，Cosmos-Policy 在 LIBERO-Plus 上的成功率达到 82.2%。虽然像 $\pi_{0.5}$ 这样的 VLA 可以在某些任务上实现相当的鲁棒性，但它们通常需要使用各种机器人数据集和不同的学习目标进行大量的训练。部分结合基于视频的动态学习的混合方法表现出中等的鲁棒性，突出了视频先验集成方式的重要性。

title: IGV-RRT: Prior-Real-Time Observation Fusion for Active Object Search in Changing Environments
summary: Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) in temporally changing indoor environments is challenging because object relocation can invalidate historical scene knowledge. To address this issue, we propose a probabilistic planning framework that combines uncertainty-aware scene priors with online target relevance estimates derived from a Vision Language Model (VLM). The framework contains a dual-layer semantic mapping module and a real-time planner. The mapping module includes an Information Gain Map (IGM) built from a 3D scene graph (3DSG) during prior exploration to model object co-occurrence relations and provide global guidance on likely target regions. It also maintains a VLM score map (VLM-SM) that fuses confidence-weighted semantic observations into the map for local validation of the current scene. Based on these two cues, we develop a planner that jointly exploits information gain and semantic evidence for online decision making. The planner biases tree expansion toward semantically salient regions with high prior likelihood and strong online relevance (IGV-RRT), while preserving kinematic feasibility through gradient-based analysis. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed method effectively mitigates the impact of object rearrangement, achieving higher search efficiency and success rates than representative baselines in complex indoor environments.
tldr: This paper introduces IGV-RRT, a probabilistic planning framework for Object Goal Navigation in changing environments, combining scene priors with online target relevance estimated by a Vision Language Model to achieve higher search efficiency and success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为IGV-RRT的概率规划框架，用于在动态环境中进行物体目标导航。该框架将场景先验知识与视觉语言模型估计的在线目标相关性相结合，实现了更高的搜索效率和成功率。
summary_zh: 在时序变化的室内环境中进行目标导向导航（ObjectNav）极具挑战性，因为物体重新安置会使历史场景知识失效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种概率规划框架，该框架结合了不确定性感知的场景先验知识与来自视觉语言模型（VLM）的在线目标相关性估计。该框架包含一个双层语义建图模块和一个实时规划器。建图模块包括一个信息增益图（IGM），它是在先验探索期间从 3D 场景图（3DSG）构建的，用于建模物体共现关系，并为可能的目标区域提供全局指导。它还维护一个 VLM 分数图（VLM-SM），该图将置信度加权的语义观测结果融合到地图中，用于对当前场景进行局部验证。基于这两个线索，我们开发了一个规划器，它联合利用信息增益和语义证据进行在线决策。该规划器将树扩展偏向于具有高先验可能性和强在线相关性的 semantically salient 区域（IGV-RRT），同时通过基于梯度的分析保持运动可行性。仿真和真实世界实验表明，所提出的方法有效地减轻了物体重排的影响，在复杂的室内环境中实现了比代表性基线更高的搜索效率和成功率。

title: Can a Robot Walk the Robotic Dog: Triple-Zero Collaborative Navigation for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
summary: We present Triple Zero Path Planning (TZPP), a collaborative framework for heterogeneous multi-robot systems that requires zero training, zero prior knowledge, and zero simulation. TZPP employs a coordinator--explorer architecture: a humanoid robot handles task coordination, while a quadruped robot explores and identifies feasible paths using guidance from a multimodal large language model. We implement TZPP on Unitree G1 and Go2 robots and evaluate it across diverse indoor and outdoor environments, including obstacle-rich and landmark-sparse settings. Experiments show that TZPP achieves robust, human-comparable efficiency and strong adaptability to unseen scenarios. By eliminating reliance on training and simulation, TZPP offers a practical path toward real-world deployment of heterogeneous robot cooperation. Our code and video are provided at: https://github.com/triple-zeropp/Triple-zero-robot-agent
tldr: The paper presents a collaborative navigation framework (TZPP) for heterogeneous robots (humanoid and quadruped) that requires no training, prior knowledge, or simulation, leveraging LLMs for path exploration and achieving human-comparable efficiency in diverse environments.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于异构机器人（人形和四足）的协作导航框架（TZPP），它不需要训练、先验知识或模拟，利用LLM进行路径探索，并在各种环境中实现了与人类相当的效率。
summary_zh: 我们提出三重零路径规划 (TZPP)，一种异构多机器人系统的协同框架，它无需训练、无需先验知识且无需仿真。TZPP 采用协调器-探索者架构：人形机器人负责任务协调，而四足机器人则利用多模态大型语言模型的指导探索并识别可行路径。我们在宇树 G1 和 Go2 机器人上实现了 TZPP，并在各种室内和室外环境中对其进行了评估，包括障碍物丰富的和地标稀疏的场景。实验表明，TZPP 实现了稳健、堪比人类的效率，并对未见场景具有强大的适应性。通过消除对训练和仿真的依赖，TZPP 为异构机器人协同的实际部署提供了一条切实可行的途径。我们的代码和视频可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/triple-zeropp/Triple-zero-robot-agent

title: PRM-as-a-Judge: A Dense Evaluation Paradigm for Fine-Grained Robotic Auditing
summary: Current robotic evaluation is still largely dominated by binary success rates, which collapse rich execution processes into a single outcome and obscure critical qualities such as progress, efficiency, and stability. To address this limitation, we propose PRM-as-a-Judge, a dense evaluation paradigm that leverages Process Reward Models (PRMs) to audit policy execution directly from trajectory videos by estimating task progress from observation sequences. Central to this paradigm is the OPD (Outcome-Process-Diagnosis) metric system, which explicitly formalizes execution quality via a task-aligned progress potential. We characterize dense robotic evaluation through two axiomatic properties: macro-consistency, which requires additive and path-consistent aggregation, and micro-resolution, which requires sensitivity to fine-grained physical evolution. Under this formulation, potential-based PRM judges provide a natural instantiation of dense evaluation, with macro-consistency following directly from the induced scalar potential. We empirically validate the micro-resolution property using RoboPulse, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed for probing micro-scale progress discrimination, where several trajectory-trained PRM judges outperform discriminative similarity-based methods and general-purpose foundation-model judges. Finally, leveraging PRM-as-a-Judge and the OPD metric system, we conduct a structured audit of mainstream policy paradigms across long-horizon tasks, revealing behavioral signatures and failure modes that are invisible to outcome-only metrics.
tldr: The paper introduces PRM-as-a-Judge, a novel dense evaluation paradigm using Process Reward Models (PRMs) to audit robot policy execution via trajectory videos, providing fine-grained insights beyond binary success rates. It includes the OPD metric system and validates against RoboPulse.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新的密集评估范式PRM-as-a-Judge，它利用过程奖励模型（PRM）通过轨迹视频来审核机器人策略的执行情况，从而提供超越二元成功率的细粒度见解。它包括OPD指标系统并已通过RoboPulse验证。
summary_zh: 当前机器人评估仍然主要采用二元成功率，这种方法将丰富的执行过程简化为单一结果，并掩盖了关键的质量指标，例如进度、效率和稳定性。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了PRM-as-a-Judge，这是一种密集评估范式，它利用过程奖励模型（PRMs）通过估计观察序列中的任务进度，直接从轨迹视频中审计策略执行过程。该范式的核心是OPD（结果-过程-诊断）度量系统，它通过任务对齐的进度势显式地形式化了执行质量。我们通过两个公理性属性来表征密集机器人评估：宏观一致性，要求具有可加性和路径一致性聚合；微观分辨率，要求对精细的物理演化具有敏感性。在这种表述下，基于势的PRM评估器提供了一种密集评估的自然实例化，其中宏观一致性直接来自诱导的标量势。我们使用RoboPulse（一个专门为探测微尺度进度区分而设计的诊断基准）对微观分辨率属性进行了实证验证，在该基准上，几个经过轨迹训练的PRM评估器优于基于判别相似度的方法和通用基础模型评估器。最后，利用PRM-as-a-Judge和OPD度量系统，我们对长时程任务中主流策略范式进行了结构化审计，揭示了仅凭结果指标无法观察到的行为特征和失效模式。

title: SafePilot: A Framework for Assuring LLM-enabled Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs), deep learning architectures with typically over 10 billion parameters, have recently begun to be integrated into various cyber-physical systems (CPS) such as robotics, industrial automation, and autopilot systems. The abstract knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs are employed for tasks like planning and navigation. However, a significant challenge arises from the tendency of LLMs to produce "hallucinations" - outputs that are coherent yet factually incorrect or contextually unsuitable. This characteristic can lead to undesirable or unsafe actions in the CPS. Therefore, our research focuses on assuring the LLM-enabled CPS by enhancing their critical properties. We propose SafePilot, a novel hierarchical neuro-symbolic framework that provides end-to-end assurance for LLM-enabled CPS according to attribute-based and temporal specifications. Given a task and its specification, SafePilot first invokes a hierarchical planner with a discriminator that assesses task complexity. If the task is deemed manageable, it is passed directly to an LLM-based task planner with built-in verification. Otherwise, the hierarchical planner applies a divide-and-conquer strategy, decomposing the task into sub-tasks, each of which is individually planned and later merged into a final solution. The LLM-based task planner translates natural language constraints into formal specifications and verifies the LLM's output against them. If violations are detected, it identifies the flaw, adjusts the prompt accordingly, and re-invokes the LLM. This iterative process continues until a valid plan is produced or a predefined limit is reached. Our framework supports LLM-enabled CPS with both attribute-based and temporal constraints. Its effectiveness and adaptability are demonstrated through two illustrative case studies.
tldr: The paper introduces SafePilot, a neuro-symbolic framework that assures the safety of LLM-enabled cyber-physical systems by verifying LLM outputs against formal specifications and iteratively refining prompts to mitigate hallucinations.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了SafePilot，一个神经符号框架，通过验证LLM输出是否符合正式规范，并迭代优化提示以减轻幻觉问题，从而确保LLM驱动的物理信息系统的安全性。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM)，参数通常超过 100 亿的深度学习架构，近期开始被集成到各种信息物理系统 (CPS) 中，例如机器人技术、工业自动化和自动驾驶系统。LLM 的抽象知识和推理能力被用于规划和导航等任务。然而，一个显著的挑战源于 LLM 产生“幻觉”的倾向——即输出连贯但事实不正确或在上下文中不适合的内容。这种特性可能导致 CPS 中出现不良或不安全的行为。因此，我们的研究重点是通过增强其关键属性来确保 LLM 驱动的 CPS 的安全性。我们提出了 SafePilot，一种新型分层神经符号框架，它根据基于属性和时序的规范，为 LLM 驱动的 CPS 提供端到端的安全性保证。给定一项任务及其规范，SafePilot 首先调用一个带有鉴别器的分层规划器，该鉴别器评估任务的复杂性。如果任务被认为是可管理的，则直接传递给具有内置验证功能的基于 LLM 的任务规划器。否则，分层规划器将应用分而治之的策略，将任务分解为子任务，然后分别对每个子任务进行规划，最后合并成一个最终解决方案。基于 LLM 的任务规划器将自然语言约束转换为形式化规范，并根据这些规范验证 LLM 的输出。如果检测到违规行为，它会识别缺陷，相应地调整提示，并重新调用 LLM。这个迭代过程持续进行，直到产生一个有效的计划或达到预定义的限制。我们的框架支持具有基于属性和时序约束的 LLM 驱动的 CPS。通过两个说明性案例研究证明了它的有效性和适应性。

title: HyReach: Vision-Guided Hybrid Manipulator Reaching in Unseen Cluttered Environments
summary: As robotic systems increasingly operate in unstructured, cluttered, and previously unseen environments, there is a growing need for manipulators that combine compliance, adaptability, and precise control. This work presents a real-time hybrid rigid-soft continuum manipulator system designed for robust open-world object reaching in such challenging environments. The system integrates vision-based perception and 3D scene reconstruction with shape-aware motion planning to generate safe trajectories. A learning-based controller drives the hybrid arm to arbitrary target poses, leveraging the flexibility of the soft segment while maintaining the precision of the rigid segment. The system operates without environment-specific retraining, enabling direct generalization to new scenes. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate consistent reaching performance with errors below 2 cm across diverse cluttered setups, highlighting the potential of hybrid manipulators for adaptive and reliable operation in unstructured environments.
tldr: This paper presents a vision-guided hybrid rigid-soft manipulator system for robust object reaching in unseen cluttered environments, demonstrating consistent performance with low errors in real-world experiments without environment-specific retraining.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种视觉引导的刚柔混合机械臂系统，用于在未见过的杂乱环境中实现稳健的物体抓取，并在真实世界的实验中展示了一致的性能和低误差，而无需针对特定环境进行重新训练。
summary_zh: 随着机器人系统越来越多地在非结构化、杂乱和先前未见的环境中运行，对兼具柔顺性、适应性和精准控制的机械臂的需求也日益增长。 本文提出了一种实时混合刚柔连续体机械臂系统，该系统专为在如此具有挑战性的环境中实现鲁棒的开放世界物体抓取而设计。 该系统集成了基于视觉的感知和3D场景重建与形状感知运动规划，以生成安全轨迹。 一种基于学习的控制器驱动混合臂到达任意目标姿态，利用软体部分的灵活性同时保持刚性部分的精度。 该系统无需针对特定环境进行重新训练即可运行，从而能够直接推广到新的场景。 大量的真实世界实验表明，在各种杂乱的设置中，抓取性能始终如一，误差低于 2 厘米，突显了混合机械臂在非结构化环境中进行自适应和可靠操作的潜力。

title: WorldCache: Content-Aware Caching for Accelerated Video World Models
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) power high-fidelity video world models but remain computationally expensive due to sequential denoising and costly spatio-temporal attention. Training-free feature caching accelerates inference by reusing intermediate activations across denoising steps; however, existing methods largely rely on a Zero-Order Hold assumption i.e., reusing cached features as static snapshots when global drift is small. This often leads to ghosting artifacts, blur, and motion inconsistencies in dynamic scenes. We propose \textbf{WorldCache}, a Perception-Constrained Dynamical Caching framework that improves both when and how to reuse features. WorldCache introduces motion-adaptive thresholds, saliency-weighted drift estimation, optimal approximation via blending and warping, and phase-aware threshold scheduling across diffusion steps. Our cohesive approach enables adaptive, motion-consistent feature reuse without retraining. On Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B evaluated on PAI-Bench, WorldCache achieves \textbf{2.3$\times$} inference speedup while preserving \textbf{99.4\%} of baseline quality, substantially outperforming prior training-free caching approaches. Our code can be accessed on \href{https://umair1221.github.io/World-Cache/}{World-Cache}.
tldr: The paper introduces WorldCache, a novel content-aware caching framework that accelerates video world model inference by adaptively reusing intermediate features, achieving significant speedups with minimal quality loss.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 WorldCache，一种新型的内容感知缓存框架，通过自适应地重用中间特征来加速视频世界模型的推理，在基本不损失质量的情况下实现了显著的加速。
summary_zh: 扩散Transformer（DiT）赋能于高保真视频世界模型，但由于串行去噪和高昂的时空注意力机制，计算成本仍然很高。免训练特征缓存通过重用去噪步骤之间的中间激活来加速推理；然而，现有方法主要依赖于零阶保持假设，即当全局漂移较小时，将缓存特征作为静态快照重用。这通常会导致动态场景中出现重影伪影、模糊和运动不一致。我们提出了 \textbf{WorldCache}，一种感知约束的动态缓存框架，它改进了何时以及如何重用特征。 WorldCache引入了运动自适应阈值、显著性加权漂移估计、通过混合和扭曲实现的最佳近似，以及跨扩散步骤的相位感知阈值调度。我们这种具有凝聚力的方法实现了自适应、运动一致的特征重用，而无需重新训练。在PAI-Bench上评估的Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B数据集上，WorldCache实现了 \textbf{2.3倍} 的推理加速，同时保留了 \textbf{99.4\%} 的基线质量，大大优于之前的免训练缓存方法。我们的代码可以在 \href{https://umair1221.github.io/World-Cache/}{World-Cache} 上访问。

title: Seeing is Improving: Visual Feedback for Iterative Text Layout Refinement
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled automated generation of structured layouts from natural language descriptions. Existing methods typically follow a code-only paradigm that generates code to represent layouts, which are then rendered by graphic engines to produce final images. However, they are blind to the rendered visual outcome, making it difficult to guarantee readability and aesthetics. In this paper, we identify visual feedback as a critical factor in layout generation and propose Visual Feedback Layout Model (VFLM), a self-improving framework that leverages visual feedback iterative refinement. VFLM is capable of performing adaptive reflective generation, which leverages visual information to reflect on previous issues and iteratively generates outputs until satisfactory quality is achieved. It is achieved through reinforcement learning with a visually grounded reward model that incorporates OCR accuracy. By rewarding only the final generated outcome, we can effectively stimulate the model's iterative and reflective generative capabilities. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that VFLM consistently outperforms advanced MLLMs, existing layout models, and code-only baselines, establishing visual feedback as critical for design-oriented MLLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/FolSpark/VFLM.
tldr: The paper introduces VFLM, a framework that uses visual feedback and reinforcement learning to iteratively refine text layouts generated by Multimodal Large Language Models, resulting in improved readability and aesthetics compared to code-only methods.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VFLM，一个使用视觉反馈和强化学习迭代优化多模态大型语言模型生成的文本布局的框架，与纯代码方法相比，提高了可读性和美观性。
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的最新进展使得从自然语言描述中自动生成结构化布局成为可能。现有方法通常遵循一种仅代码范式，即生成代码来表示布局，然后通过图形引擎渲染以产生最终图像。然而，它们对渲染的视觉结果是盲目的，因此难以保证可读性和美观性。在本文中，我们认为视觉反馈是布局生成的关键因素，并提出了视觉反馈布局模型（VFLM），这是一个利用视觉反馈进行迭代改进的自我提升框架。VFLM能够执行自适应的反思性生成，即利用视觉信息来反思先前的问题，并迭代生成输出，直到达到令人满意的质量。这通过强化学习来实现，采用了一个包含OCR准确率的视觉基础奖励模型。通过仅对最终生成的成果进行奖励，我们可以有效地激发模型的迭代和反思性生成能力。跨多个基准的实验表明，VFLM始终优于先进的MLLM、现有布局模型以及仅代码基线，从而确立了视觉反馈对于面向设计的MLLM的重要性。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/FolSpark/VFLM 获取。

title: Beyond Matching to Tiles: Bridging Unaligned Aerial and Satellite Views for Vision-Only UAV Navigation
summary: Recent advances in cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) methods have shown strong potential for supporting unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation in GNSS-denied environments. However, existing work predominantly focuses on matching UAV views to onboard map tiles, which introduces an inherent trade-off between accuracy and storage overhead, and overlooks the importance of the UAV's heading during navigation. Moreover, the substantial discrepancies and varying overlaps in cross-view scenarios have been insufficiently considered, limiting their generalization to real-world scenarios. In this paper, we present Bearing-UAV, a purely vision-driven cross-view navigation method that jointly predicts UAV absolute location and heading from neighboring features, enabling accurate, lightweight, and robust navigation in the wild. Our method leverages global and local structural features and explicitly encodes relative spatial relationships, making it robust to cross-view variations, misalignment, and feature-sparse conditions. We also present Bearing-UAV-90k, a multi-city benchmark for evaluating cross-view localization and navigation. Extensive experiments show encouraging results that Bearing-UAV yields lower localization error than previous matching/retrieval paradigm across diverse terrains. Our code and dataset will be made publicly available.
tldr: The paper introduces Bearing-UAV, a vision-driven cross-view navigation method for UAVs that jointly predicts location and heading, addressing limitations of tile-matching approaches and enhancing robustness in complex real-world scenarios. They also provide a new multi-city benchmark dataset.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了Bearing-UAV，一种视觉驱动的无人机跨视角导航方法，它联合预测位置和航向，解决了瓦片匹配方法的局限性，并提高了在复杂的真实场景中的鲁棒性。他们还提供了一个新的多城市基准数据集。
summary_zh: 近年来，跨视角地理定位 (CVGL) 方法在支持全球导航卫星系统 (GNSS) 受限环境下的无人机 (UAV) 导航方面展现出了巨大的潜力。然而，现有的工作主要集中于将无人机视角与机载地图瓦片进行匹配，这引入了精度和存储开销之间的内在权衡，并忽略了无人机在导航过程中的航向的重要性。此外，跨视角场景中存在的巨大差异和变化的重叠区域尚未得到充分考虑，这限制了其在现实场景中的泛化能力。在本文中，我们提出了一种纯视觉驱动的跨视角导航方法 Bearing-UAV，该方法联合预测无人机的绝对位置和来自相邻特征的航向，从而实现野外环境下精确、轻量级和鲁棒的导航。我们的方法利用全局和局部结构特征，并显式地编码了相对空间关系，使其对跨视角变化、错位和特征稀疏条件具有鲁棒性。我们还提出了 Bearing-UAV-90k，这是一个用于评估跨视角定位和导航的多城市基准。大量的实验表明，与先前的匹配/检索范式相比，Bearing-UAV 在各种地形上产生了更低的定位误差，效果令人鼓舞。我们的代码和数据集将公开发布。

title: TREX: Trajectory Explanations for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated its ability to solve complex decision-making problems in a variety of domains, by optimizing reward signals obtained through interaction with an environment. However, many real-world scenarios involve multiple, potentially conflicting objectives that cannot be easily represented by a single scalar reward. Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) addresses this limitation by enabling agents to optimize several objectives simultaneously, explicitly reasoning about trade-offs between them. However, the ``black box" nature of the RL models makes the decision process behind chosen objective trade-offs unclear. Current Explainable Reinforcement Learning (XRL) methods are typically designed for single scalar rewards and do not account for explanations with respect to distinct objectives or user preferences. To address this gap, in this paper we propose TREX, a Trajectory based Explainability framework to explain Multi-objective Reinforcement Learning policies, based on trajectory attribution.
  TREX generates trajectories directly from the learned expert policy, across different user preferences and clusters them into semantically meaningful temporal segments. We quantify the influence of these behavioural segments on the Pareto trade-off by training complementary policies that exclude specific clusters, measuring the resulting relative deviation on the observed rewards and actions compared to the original expert policy. Experiments on multi-objective MuJoCo environments - HalfCheetah, Ant and Swimmer, demonstrate the framework's ability to isolate and quantify the specific behavioural patterns.
tldr: This paper introduces TREX, a trajectory-based explainability framework for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) that identifies and quantifies the influence of behavioral segments on Pareto trade-offs under different user preferences. It demonstrates the framework's capabilities on MuJoCo environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于轨迹的可解释性框架TREX，用于多目标强化学习 (MORL)。该框架通过识别和量化行为片段对不同用户偏好下帕累托权衡的影响，来解释 MORL 策略。 并在 MuJoCo 环境中展示了该框架的能力。
summary_zh:
强化学习（RL）已经展示了其在各种领域解决复杂决策问题的能力，通过优化与环境交互获得的奖励信号。然而，许多现实世界场景涉及多个可能冲突的目标，这些目标难以用单一标量奖励来简单表示。多目标强化学习（MORL）通过使智能体能够同时优化多个目标，显式地推理它们之间的权衡，从而解决了这一局限性。然而，RL模型的“黑盒”性质使得选定的目标权衡背后的决策过程不明确。目前的解释性强化学习（XRL）方法通常是为单一标量奖励设计的，没有考虑针对不同目标或用户偏好的解释。为了弥补这一差距，本文提出了一种名为TREX的基于轨迹的解释性框架，旨在基于轨迹归因来解释多目标强化学习策略。

TREX框架直接从学习到的专家策略生成不同用户偏好下的轨迹，并将它们聚类成具有语义意义的时间片段。我们通过训练排除特定聚类的互补策略来量化这些行为片段对帕累托权衡的影响，并测量与原始专家策略相比在观察到的奖励和动作上的相对偏差。在多目标MuJoCo环境——HalfCheetah、Ant和Swimmer上的实验表明，该框架能够隔离和量化特定的行为模式。

title: P^2O: Joint Policy and Prompt Optimization
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, vanilla RLVR suffers from inefficient exploration, particularly when confronting "hard samples" that yield nearzero success rates. In such scenarios, the reliance on sparse outcome rewards typically results in zero-advantage estimates, effectively starving the model of supervision signals despite the high informational value of these instances. To address this, we propose P^2O, a novel framework that synergizes Prompt Optimization with Policy Optimization. P^2O identifies hard samples during training iterations and leverages the GeneticPareto (GEPA) prompt optimization algorithm to evolve prompt templates that guide the model toward discovering successful trajectories. Crucially, unlike traditional prompt engineering methods that rely on input augmentation, P^2O distills the reasoning gains induced by these optimized prompts directly into the model parameters. This mechanism provides denser positive supervision signals for hard samples and accelerates convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that P^2O not only achieves superior performance on in-distribution datasets but also exhibits strong generalization, yielding substantial improvements on out-of-distribution benchmarks (+4.7% avg.).
tldr: The paper introduces P^2O, a framework that combines prompt optimization with policy optimization in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to improve exploration and performance, especially on hard samples, by distilling prompt-induced reasoning gains directly into the model parameters.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 P^2O，一个将提示优化与策略优化相结合的框架，应用于可验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR)，通过将提示引致的推理增益直接提取到模型参数中，从而提高探索效率和性能，尤其是在处理困难样本时。
summary_zh: 经验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)已成为增强大型语言模型(LLM)推理能力的强大范式。然而，原始RLVR存在探索效率低下的问题，尤其是在面对产生近乎零成功率的“硬样本”时。在这种情况下，对稀疏结果奖励的依赖通常会导致零优势估计，尽管这些实例具有很高的信息价值，但实际上模型缺乏监督信号。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的框架P^2O，它协同了提示优化与策略优化。P^2O在训练迭代期间识别硬样本，并利用GeneticPareto (GEPA)提示优化算法来进化提示模板，引导模型发现成功的轨迹。至关重要的是，与依赖输入增强的传统提示工程方法不同，P^2O将这些优化提示带来的推理增益直接提炼到模型参数中。这种机制为硬样本提供了更密集的积极监督信号，并加速了收敛。大量实验表明，P^2O不仅在同分布数据集上取得了优异的性能，而且表现出强大的泛化能力，在异分布基准测试中也取得了显著的改进（平均+4.7%）。

title: EnterpriseLab: A Full-Stack Platform for developing and deploying agents in Enterprises
summary: Deploying AI agents in enterprise environments requires balancing capability with data sovereignty and cost constraints. While small language models offer privacy-preserving alternatives to frontier models, their specialization is hindered by fragmented development pipelines that separate tool integration, data generation, and training. We introduce EnterpriseLab, a full-stack platform that unifies these stages into a closed-loop framework. EnterpriseLab provides (1) a modular environment exposing enterprise applications via Model Context Protocol, enabling seamless integration of proprietary and open-source tools; (2) automated trajectory synthesis that programmatically generates training data from environment schemas; and (3) integrated training pipelines with continuous evaluation. We validate the platform through EnterpriseArena, an instantiation with 15 applications and 140+ tools across IT, HR, sales, and engineering domains. Our results demonstrate that 8B-parameter models trained within EnterpriseLab match GPT-4o's performance on complex enterprise workflows while reducing inference costs by 8-10x, and remain robust across diverse enterprise benchmarks, including EnterpriseBench (+10%) and CRMArena (+10%). EnterpriseLab provides enterprises a practical path to deploying capable, privacy-preserving agents without compromising operational capability.
tldr: The paper introduces EnterpriseLab, a full-stack platform for training and deploying small language models in enterprise environments, showing performance comparable to GPT-4o with reduced cost and improved privacy.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 EnterpriseLab，一个用于在企业环境中训练和部署小型语言模型的全栈平台，它展示了与 GPT-4o 相当的性能，同时降低了成本并提高了隐私。
summary_zh: 在企业环境中部署人工智能体需要在能力、数据主权和成本约束之间取得平衡。虽然小型语言模型为前沿模型提供了保护隐私的替代方案，但碎片化的开发流程（将工具集成、数据生成和训练分离）阻碍了它们的专业化。我们引入了EnterpriseLab，一个全栈平台，将这些阶段统一到一个闭环框架中。EnterpriseLab提供：（1）一个模块化环境，通过模型上下文协议暴露企业应用程序，实现专有和开源工具的无缝集成；（2）自动轨迹合成，能够从环境模式中以编程方式生成训练数据；以及（3）集成训练流水线，具有持续评估功能。我们通过EnterpriseArena验证了该平台，这是一个包含IT、人力资源、销售和工程等领域15个应用程序和140多个工具的实例化应用。我们的结果表明，在EnterpriseLab中训练的80亿参数模型在复杂的企业工作流程上与GPT-4o的性能相匹配，同时降低了8-10倍的推理成本，并在包括EnterpriseBench（+10%）和CRMArena（+10%）在内的各种企业基准测试中保持了稳健性。EnterpriseLab为企业提供了一条部署强大且保护隐私的Agent的实用途径，而不会牺牲运营能力。

title: Mind over Space: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Mentally Navigate?
summary: Despite the widespread adoption of MLLMs in embodied agents, their capabilities remain largely confined to reactive planning from immediate observations, consistently failing in spatial reasoning across extensive spatiotemporal scales. Cognitive science reveals that Biological Intelligence (BI) thrives on "mental navigation": the strategic construction of spatial representations from experience and the subsequent mental simulation of paths prior to action. To bridge the gap between AI and BI, we introduce Video2Mental, a pioneering benchmark for evaluating the mental navigation capabilities of MLLMs. The task requires constructing hierarchical cognitive maps from long egocentric videos and generating landmark-based path plans step by step, with planning accuracy verified through simulator-based physical interaction. Our benchmarking results reveal that mental navigation capability does not naturally emerge from standard pre-training. Frontier MLLMs struggle profoundly with zero-shot structured spatial representation, and their planning accuracy decays precipitously over extended horizons. To overcome this, we propose \textbf{NavMind}, a reasoning model that internalizes mental navigation using explicit, fine-grained cognitive maps as learnable intermediate representations. Through a difficulty-stratified progressive supervised fine-tuning paradigm, NavMind effectively bridges the gap between raw perception and structured planning. Experiments demonstrate that NavMind achieves superior mental navigation capabilities, significantly outperforming frontier commercial and spatial MLLMs.
tldr: The paper introduces Video2Mental, a benchmark for evaluating mental navigation in MLLMs, and NavMind, a model that significantly outperforms existing MLLMs in this task by using explicit cognitive maps. The research highlights the limitations of current MLLMs in spatial reasoning and offers a solution using fine-grained cognitive maps.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Video2Mental，一个用于评估 MLLM 中心理导航能力的基准，以及 NavMind，一个通过使用显式认知地图在这一任务中显著优于现有 MLLM 的模型。该研究强调了当前 MLLM 在空间推理方面的局限性，并提供了一个使用细粒度认知地图的解决方案。
summary_zh: 尽管多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在具身智能体中得到广泛应用，但它们的能力仍然很大程度上局限于对直接观察结果的反应式规划，始终无法在广泛时空尺度上进行空间推理。认知科学揭示，生物智能（BI）依赖于“心智导航”：从经验中战略性地构建空间表征，并在行动之前进行后续路径的心理模拟。为了弥合人工智能与生物智能之间的差距，我们推出了Video2Mental，这是一个用于评估MLLMs心智导航能力的开创性基准。该任务要求从长篇自我中心视频中构建分层认知地图，并逐步生成基于地标的路径规划，并通过基于模拟器的物理交互验证规划准确性。我们的基准测试结果表明，心智导航能力并非自然地从标准预训练中涌现出来。前沿多模态大型语言模型在零样本结构化空间表征方面表现出很大的困难，并且它们的规划准确性在延长的视野范围内急剧下降。为了克服这一点，我们提出了\textbf{NavMind}，一种推理模型，它使用显式、细粒度的认知地图作为可学习的中间表征来内化心智导航。通过一种难度分层的渐进式监督微调模式，NavMind有效地弥合了原始感知和结构化规划之间的差距。实验表明，NavMind实现了卓越的心智导航能力，显著超越了前沿商业和空间多模态大型语言模型。

title: Adaptive Robust Estimator for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models, yet it suffers from interaction-level ambiguity that blurs generation, critique, and revision, making credit assignment across agents difficult. Moreover, policy optimization in this setting is vulnerable to heavy-tailed and noisy rewards, which can bias advantage estimation and trigger unstable or even divergent training. To address both issues, we propose a robust multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for collaborative reasoning, consisting of two components: Dual-Agent Answer-Critique-Rewrite (DACR) and an Adaptive Robust Estimator (ARE). DACR decomposes reasoning into a structured three-stage pipeline: answer, critique, and rewrite, while enabling explicit attribution of each agent's marginal contribution to its partner's performance. ARE provides robust estimation of batch experience means during multi-agent policy optimization. Across mathematical reasoning and embodied intelligence benchmarks, even under noisy rewards, our method consistently outperforms the baseline in both homogeneous and heterogeneous settings. These results indicate stronger robustness to reward noise and more stable training dynamics, effectively preventing optimization failures caused by noisy reward signals.
tldr: This paper introduces a robust multi-agent reinforcement learning framework (DACR & ARE) to address credit assignment and reward noise issues in collaborative LLM reasoning, demonstrating superior performance on mathematical reasoning and embodied intelligence benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种鲁棒的多智能体强化学习框架（DACR & ARE），旨在解决协同LLM推理中的信用分配和奖励噪声问题，并在数学推理和具身智能基准测试中表现出卓越的性能。
summary_zh: 多智能体协作已成为增强大型语言模型推理能力的强大范式，但它存在交互层面的模糊性，使得生成、评价和修改之间的界限变得模糊，从而导致智能体之间的信用分配困难。此外，在这种设置下的策略优化容易受到重尾和噪声奖励的影响，这会偏离优势估计并触发不稳定甚至发散的训练。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了一种用于协同推理的鲁棒多智能体强化学习框架，该框架由两个组成部分构成：双智能体回答-评价-重写 (DACR) 和自适应鲁棒估计器 (ARE)。 DACR 将推理分解为结构化的三个阶段的流程：回答、评价和重写，同时能够显式地将每个智能体对其伙伴性能的边际贡献进行归因。 ARE 提供了多智能体策略优化过程中批量经验均值的鲁棒估计。在数学推理和具身智能基准测试中，即使在存在噪声奖励的情况下，我们的方法在同构和异构设置中都始终优于基线。这些结果表明其对奖励噪声具有更强的鲁棒性和更稳定的训练动态，有效地防止了由噪声奖励信号引起的优化失败。

title: What Do World Models Learn in RL? Probing Latent Representations in Learned Environment Simulators
summary: World models learn to simulate environment dynamics from experience, enabling sample-efficient reinforcement learning. But what do these models actually represent internally? We apply interpretability techniques--including linear and nonlinear probing, causal interventions, and attention analysis--to two architecturally distinct world models: IRIS (discrete token transformer) and DIAMOND (continuous diffusion UNet), trained on Atari Breakout and Pong. Using linear probes, we find that both models develop linearly decodable representations of game state variables (object positions, scores), with MLP probes yielding only marginally higher R^2, confirming that these representations are approximately linear. Causal interventions--shifting hidden states along probe-derived directions--produce correlated changes in model predictions, providing evidence that representations are functionally used rather than merely correlated. Analysis of IRIS attention heads reveals spatial specialization: specific heads attend preferentially to tokens overlapping with game objects. Multi-baseline token ablation experiments consistently identify object-containing tokens as disproportionately important. Our findings provide interpretability evidence that learned world models develop structured, approximately linear internal representations of environment state across two games and two architectures.
tldr: This paper investigates the internal representations of world models trained on Atari games, finding evidence of structured, approximately linear representations of environment state variables across different architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在Atari游戏中训练的世界模型的内部表征，发现不同架构中存在环境状态变量的结构化、近似线性的表征的证据。
summary_zh: 世界模型通过经验学习模拟环境动态，从而实现样本高效的强化学习。但这些模型实际上在内部表示什么呢？我们对两种架构不同的世界模型：在Atari Breakout和Pong上训练的IRIS（离散token transformer）和DIAMOND（连续扩散UNet），应用了可解释性技术——包括线性和非线性探针、因果干预和注意力分析。使用线性探针，我们发现这两种模型都发展了游戏状态变量（物体位置、得分）的线性可解码表示，而MLP探针仅产生略高的R^2，证实这些表示是近似线性的。因果干预——沿着探针导出的方向移动隐藏状态——在模型预测中产生相关的变化，提供了表示被功能性地使用而不是仅仅相关的证据。对IRIS注意力头的分析揭示了空间专业化：特定的头优先关注与游戏对象重叠的token。多基线token消融实验一致识别出包含对象的token具有不成比例的重要性。我们的发现提供了可解释性证据，表明学习到的世界模型在两个游戏和两个架构中都发展了环境状态的结构化、近似线性的内部表示。

title: Silent Commitment Failure in Instruction-Tuned Language Models: Evidence of Governability Divergence Across Architectures
summary: As large language models are deployed as autonomous agents with tool execution privileges, a critical assumption underpins their security architecture: that model errors are detectable at runtime. We present empirical evidence that this assumption fails for two of three instruction-following models evaluable for conflict detection. We introduce governability -- the degree to which a model's errors are detectable before output commitment and correctable once detected -- and demonstrate it varies dramatically across models. In six models across twelve reasoning domains, two of three instruction-following models exhibited silent commitment failure: confident, fluent, incorrect output with zero warning signal. The remaining model produced a detectable conflict signal 57 tokens before commitment under greedy decoding. We show benchmark accuracy does not predict governability, correction capacity varies independently of detection, and identical governance scaffolds produce opposite effects across models. A 2x2 experiment shows a 52x difference in spike ratio between architectures but only +/-0.32x variation from fine-tuning, suggesting governability is fixed at pretraining. We propose a Detection and Correction Matrix classifying model-task combinations into four regimes: Governable, Monitor Only, Steer Blind, and Ungovernable.
tldr: This paper identifies a critical failure mode in instruction-tuned LLMs, termed 'silent commitment failure,' where models confidently produce incorrect outputs without any prior warning. Governability, the ability to detect and correct errors, varies significantly across different LLM architectures and is impacted more by pretraining than fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文指出指令微调的大语言模型中存在一种关键的失效模式，称为“沉默提交失败”，即模型自信地产生不正确的结果，而没有任何事先警告。可治理性（检测和纠正错误的能力）在不同的大语言模型架构之间差异很大，并且受预训练的影响大于微调。
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型作为具有工具执行权限的自主代理被部署，一个关键假设支撑着其安全架构：即模型错误可以在运行时被检测到。我们提供经验证据表明，对于三个可以评估冲突检测能力的指令跟随模型中的两个，这个假设并不成立。我们引入了可治理性——模型错误在输出提交之前可被检测到并于检测后可被纠正的程度——并证明它在不同模型之间差异巨大。在涵盖十二个推理领域的六个模型中，三个指令跟随模型中的两个表现出静默提交失败：自信、流畅、不正确的输出，且没有任何预警信号。剩余的模型在贪婪解码下，于提交前 57 个 tokens 产生了一个可检测的冲突信号。我们表明，基准准确率并不能预测可治理性，纠正能力的变化独立于检测能力，并且相同的治理框架在不同模型上产生相反的效果。一个 2x2 的实验显示，架构之间的峰值比差异为 52 倍，但微调仅带来 +/-0.32 倍的变化，表明可治理性在预训练阶段就已经确定。我们提出了一个检测与纠正矩阵，将模型-任务组合分为四个状态：可治理、仅监控、盲操纵和不可治理。

title: AgentHER: Hindsight Experience Replay for LLM Agent Trajectory Relabeling
summary: LLM agents fail on the majority of real-world tasks -- GPT-4o succeeds on fewer than 15% of WebArena navigation tasks and below 55% pass@1 on ToolBench (Zhou et al., 2024; Qin et al., 2024) -- yet every failed trajectory is routinely discarded, wasting the dominant source of collected experience. We introduce AgentHER, a framework that recovers this lost training signal by adapting the Hindsight Experience Replay (HER; Andrychowicz et al., 2017) principle to natural-language agent trajectories for offline data augmentation. The key insight is simple: a trajectory that fails goal A is often a correct demonstration for some achievable alternative goal B. AgentHER realises this idea through a four-stage pipeline -- failure classification, outcome extraction, LLM-guided prompt relabeling with confidence gating, and data packaging -- that converts discarded failures into high-quality SFT, DPO, and ShareGPT training data, with both zero-cost rule-based and LLM-judge implementations. On WebArena (Zhou et al., 2024) and ToolBench (Qin et al., 2024), AgentHER improves over success-only SFT by +7.1-11.7 pp across four model families (GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72B/7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B), while achieving 2x data efficiency -- matching baseline performance with only 50% of successful demonstrations. Gains are consistent from 1.5B to 72B parameters (+5.8-9.2 pp) and compound under iterative redeployment (+2.1 pp over additional rounds). Human evaluation confirms 97.7% relabeling precision under multi-judge verification.
tldr: The paper introduces AgentHER, a method adapting Hindsight Experience Replay to relabel failed LLM agent trajectories as successful demonstrations for alternative goals, improving performance and data efficiency on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为AgentHER的方法，该方法将后见之明经验回放（Hindsight Experience Replay）应用于大型语言模型（LLM）代理，将失败的轨迹重新标记为针对替代目标的成功演示，从而提高在现实世界任务中的性能和数据效率。
summary_zh: 大语言模型代理在大多数真实世界任务中表现不佳——GPT-4o 在 WebArena 导航任务中的成功率低于 15%，在 ToolBench (Zhou et al., 2024; Qin et al., 2024) 上的 pass@1 低于 55%——然而，每个失败的轨迹通常被丢弃，浪费了收集经验的主要来源。我们引入了 AgentHER，一个通过将后见之明经验回放 (HER; Andrychowicz et al., 2017) 原则适配到自然语言代理轨迹，来进行离线数据增强的框架。其核心思想很简单：一个未能达成目标 A 的轨迹通常是达成某个可实现的替代目标 B 的正确示范。AgentHER 通过一个四阶段流程来实现这个想法——失败分类、结果提取、基于大语言模型的提示重标记并进行置信度门控、以及数据打包——将丢弃的失败转化为高质量的 SFT、DPO 和 ShareGPT 训练数据，具有零成本的基于规则的实现和大语言模型评判实现。在 WebArena (Zhou et al., 2024) 和 ToolBench (Qin et al., 2024) 上，AgentHER 相对于仅使用成功数据的 SFT，在四个模型系列（GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72B/7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B）上实现了 +7.1-11.7 个百分点的提升，同时实现了 2 倍的数据效率——仅使用 50% 的成功演示即可达到基线性能。从 15 亿到 720 亿参数，增益是一致的 (+5.8-9.2 个百分点)，并在迭代重新部署中会累积增加(+2.1 个百分点）。人工评估证实，在多评判者验证下，重标记精度为 97.7%。

title: ACPO: Counteracting Likelihood Displacement in Vision-Language Alignment with Asymmetric Constraints
summary: While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become the de facto approach for aligning Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), it suffers from Likelihood Displacement, where the probability of both chosen and rejected responses collapses. This optimization flaw is especially detrimental in multimodal settings: the erosion of chosen likelihoods -- a failure we term Visual Anchor Collapse -- causes models to abandon visual evidence for strong language priors, precipitating significant hallucinations. To address this, we propose Asymmetric Constrained Preference Optimization (ACPO), a modality-agnostic alignment mechanism that applies dynamic, target-oriented scaling to preference optimization. ACPO derives a complexity-aware scaling coefficient applied exclusively to the rejected reward, asymmetrically suppressing the gradient flow on the rejected term while preserving the chosen distribution as a gradient-stable reference. While fundamentally a general-purpose objective, breaking this gradient symmetry is crucial for multimodal tasks, as it mitigates the suppression of visual tokens by language priors. Experiments on InternVL models demonstrate that ACPO effectively reverses the chosen-reward degradation of standard DPO. By halting Visual Anchor Collapse, ACPO generally outperforms baselines on hallucination benchmarks (HallusionBench, MM-IFEval) and general leaderboards (MMBench, MMStar, OCRBenchV2) while driving concurrent improvements in general capabilities.
tldr: The paper introduces Asymmetric Constrained Preference Optimization (ACPO) to address the Likelihood Displacement problem in Vision-Language alignment, specifically Visual Anchor Collapse, which leads to hallucinations. ACPO improves performance on hallucination and general capability benchmarks by preserving visual evidence.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种非对称约束偏好优化 (ACPO) 方法，以解决视觉-语言对齐中的似然位移问题，特别是导致幻觉的视觉锚点崩溃。ACPO 通过保留视觉证据，提高了在幻觉和通用能力基准测试上的性能。
summary_zh: 直接偏好优化(DPO)已成为对齐大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)的事实标准方法，但其存在似然位移问题，即选择和拒绝响应的概率都会崩塌。这种优化缺陷在多模态设置中尤其有害：选择响应的似然侵蚀——我们称之为视觉锚点崩塌——导致模型放弃视觉证据而倾向于强语言先验，从而引发显著的幻觉。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了非对称约束偏好优化(ACPO)，这是一种模态无关的对齐机制，它对偏好优化应用动态的、目标导向的缩放。ACPO推导出一个复杂性感知的缩放系数，专门应用于拒绝的奖励，非对称地抑制拒绝项上的梯度流动，同时保持选择响应的分布作为梯度稳定的参考。虽然ACPO本质上是一个通用的目标函数，但打破这种梯度对称性对于多模态任务至关重要，因为它减轻了语言先验对视觉token的抑制。在InternVL模型上的实验表明，ACPO有效地逆转了标准DPO中选择奖励的退化。通过阻止视觉锚点崩塌，ACPO在幻觉基准测试（HallusionBench, MM-IFEval）和通用排行榜（MMBench, MMStar, OCRBenchV2）上通常优于基线方法，同时推动了一般能力的同步提升。

title: StreamingClaw Technical Report
summary: Applications such as embodied intelligence rely on a real-time perception-decision-action closed loop, posing stringent challenges for streaming video understanding. However, current agents suffer from fragmented capabilities, such as supporting only offline video understanding, lacking long-term multimodal memory mechanisms, or struggling to achieve real-time reasoning and proactive interaction under streaming inputs. These shortcomings have become a key bottleneck for preventing them from sustaining perception, making real-time decisions, and executing actions in real-world environments. To alleviate these issues, we propose StreamingClaw, a unified agent framework for streaming video understanding and embodied intelligence. It is also an OpenClaw-compatible framework that supports real-time, multimodal streaming interaction. StreamingClaw integrates five core capabilities: (1) It supports real-time streaming reasoning. (2) It supports reasoning about future events and proactive interaction under the online evolution of interaction objectives. (3) It supports multimodal long-term storage, hierarchical evolution, and efficient retrieval of shared memory across multiple agents. (4) It supports a closed-loop of perception-decision-action. In addition to conventional tools and skills, it also provides streaming tools and action-centric skills tailored for real-world physical environments. (5) It is compatible with the OpenClaw framework, allowing it to fully leverage the resources and support of the open-source community. With these designs, StreamingClaw integrates online real-time reasoning, multimodal long-term memory, and proactive interaction within a unified framework. Moreover, by translating decisions into executable actions, it enables direct control of the physical world, supporting practical deployment of embodied interaction.
tldr: The paper introduces StreamingClaw, a unified agent framework designed for real-time streaming video understanding and embodied intelligence, featuring multimodal long-term memory, proactive interaction, and compatibility with the OpenClaw framework.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了StreamingClaw，一个为实时流视频理解和具身智能设计的统一代理框架，具有多模态长期记忆、主动交互以及与OpenClaw框架的兼容性。
summary_zh: 具身智能等应用依赖于实时的感知-决策-行动闭环，对流式视频理解提出了严峻的挑战。然而，目前的智能体存在能力碎片化的问题，例如仅支持离线视频理解、缺乏长期多模态记忆机制，或难以在流式输入下实现实时推理和主动交互。这些缺点已成为阻碍它们在真实世界环境中维持感知、做出实时决策和执行行动的关键瓶颈。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了StreamingClaw，一个统一的智能体框架，用于流式视频理解和具身智能。它也是一个与OpenClaw兼容的框架，支持实时的多模态流式交互。StreamingClaw集成了五个核心能力：（1）它支持实时流式推理。（2）它支持对未来事件的推理，以及在交互目标在线演进下的主动交互。（3）它支持跨多个智能体的多模态长期存储、分层演进和高效检索共享记忆。（4）它支持感知-决策-行动的闭环。除了传统的工具和技能之外，它还提供针对真实物理环境量身定制的流式工具和以行动为中心的技能。（5）它与OpenClaw框架兼容，使其能够充分利用开源社区的资源和支持。凭借这些设计，StreamingClaw在一个统一的框架内集成了在线实时推理、多模态长期记忆和主动交互。此外，通过将决策转化为可执行的行动，它能够直接控制物理世界，从而支持具身交互的实际部署。

title: Group3D: MLLM-Driven Semantic Grouping for Open-Vocabulary 3D Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection aims to localize and recognize objects beyond a fixed training taxonomy. In multi-view RGB settings, recent approaches often decouple geometry-based instance construction from semantic labeling, generating class-agnostic fragments and assigning open-vocabulary categories post hoc. While flexible, such decoupling leaves instance construction governed primarily by geometric consistency, without semantic constraints during merging. When geometric evidence is view-dependent and incomplete, this geometry-only merging can lead to irreversible association errors, including over-merging of distinct objects or fragmentation of a single instance. We propose Group3D, a multi-view open-vocabulary 3D detection framework that integrates semantic constraints directly into the instance construction process. Group3D maintains a scene-adaptive vocabulary derived from a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and organizes it into semantic compatibility groups that encode plausible cross-view category equivalence. These groups act as merge-time constraints: 3D fragments are associated only when they satisfy both semantic compatibility and geometric consistency. This semantically gated merging mitigates geometry-driven over-merging while absorbing multi-view category variability. Group3D supports both pose-known and pose-free settings, relying only on RGB observations. Experiments on ScanNet and ARKitScenes demonstrate that Group3D achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-view open-vocabulary 3D detection, while exhibiting strong generalization in zero-shot scenarios. The project page is available at https://ubin108.github.io/Group3D/.
tldr: The paper introduces Group3D, a novel multi-view open-vocabulary 3D detection framework that incorporates semantic constraints from MLLMs into the instance construction process, achieving state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 Group3D，一种新颖的多视角开放词汇 3D 检测框架，它将来自 MLLM 的语义约束整合到实例构建过程中，实现了最先进的性能和强大的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 开放词汇3D物体检测旨在定位和识别超出固定训练分类体系的物体。 在多视角RGB设置中，最近的方法通常将基于几何体的实例构建与语义标注分离，生成类别无关的碎片，并在事后分配开放词汇类别。 尽管这种方法具有灵活性，但这种分离使得实例构建主要受几何一致性支配，在合并过程中缺乏语义约束。 当几何证据具有视角依赖性和不完整性时，这种仅基于几何体的合并可能导致不可逆的关联错误，包括对不同物体的过度合并或对单个实例的碎片化。 我们提出了Group3D，一种多视角开放词汇3D检测框架，它将语义约束直接集成到实例构建过程中。 Group3D维护一个从多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）导出的场景自适应词汇表，并将其组织成语义兼容性组，以编码合理的跨视角类别等价性。 这些组充当合并时约束：只有当3D碎片同时满足语义兼容性和几何一致性时，才会被关联。 这种语义门控的合并减轻了几何驱动的过度合并，同时吸收了多视角类别可变性。 Group3D支持已知姿态和无姿态设置，仅依赖于RGB观测。 在ScanNet和ARKitScenes上的实验表明，Group3D在多视角开放词汇3D检测中实现了最先进的性能，同时在零样本场景中表现出强大的泛化能力。 项目主页地址为：https://ubin108.github.io/Group3D/。
