title: Image-Conditioned Adaptive Parameter Tuning for Visual Odometry Frontends
summary: Resource-constrained autonomous robots rely on sparse direct and semi-direct visual-(inertial)-odometry (VO) pipelines, as they provide a favorable tradeoff between accuracy, robustness, and computational cost. However, the performance of most systems depends critically on hand-tuned hyperparameters governing feature detection, tracking, and outlier rejection. These parameters are typically fixed during deployment, even though their optimal values vary with scene characteristics such as texture density, illumination, motion blur, and sensor noise, leading to brittle performance in real-world environments. We propose the first image-conditioned reinforcement learning framework for online tuning of VO frontend parameters, effectively embedding the expert into the system. Our key idea is to formulate the frontend configuration as a sequential decision-making problem and learn a policy that directly maps visual input to feature detection and tracking parameters. The policy uses a lightweight texture-aware CNN encoder and a privileged critic during training. Unlike prior RL-based approaches that rely solely on internal VO statistics, our method observes the image content and proactively adapts parameters before tracking degrades. Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TUM RGB-D show 3x longer feature tracks and 3x lower computational cost, despite training entirely in simulation.
tldr: The paper introduces an image-conditioned reinforcement learning framework that dynamically tunes visual odometry frontend parameters based on visual input, leading to improved performance and efficiency in resource-constrained robotic systems.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种图像条件强化学习框架，该框架能够基于视觉输入动态调整视觉里程计前端参数，从而提高资源受限的机器人系统的性能和效率。
summary_zh: 资源受限的自主机器人依赖于稀疏的直接和半直接视觉-(惯性)-里程计 (VO) 流水线，因为它们在精度、鲁棒性和计算成本之间提供了良好的折衷。然而，大多数系统的性能关键取决于手动调整的超参数，这些超参数控制着特征检测、跟踪和异常值剔除。这些参数通常在部署期间是固定的，即使它们的最佳值随场景特征（如纹理密度、光照、运动模糊和传感器噪声）而变化，导致在真实世界环境中性能不稳定。我们提出了第一个图像条件强化学习框架，用于在线调整 VO 前端参数，有效地将专家嵌入到系统中。 我们的核心思想是将前端配置表述为一个序列决策问题，并学习一种策略，该策略直接将视觉输入映射到特征检测和跟踪参数。该策略使用轻量级的纹理感知 CNN 编码器和训练期间的特权评论员。 与先前仅依赖于内部 VO 统计数据的基于 RL 的方法不同，我们的方法观察图像内容并在跟踪性能下降之前主动调整参数。在 TartanAirV2 和 TUM RGB-D 上的实验表明，尽管完全在仿真中训练，但实现了 3 倍更长的特征跟踪和 3 倍更低的计算成本。

title: From Part to Whole: 3D Generative World Model with an Adaptive Structural Hierarchy
summary: Single-image 3D generation lies at the core of vision-to-graphics models in the real world. However, it remains a fundamental challenge to achieve reliable generalization across diverse semantic categories and highly variable structural complexity under sparse supervision. Existing approaches typically model objects in a monolithic manner or rely on a fixed number of parts, including recent part-aware models such as PartCrafter, which still require a labor-intensive user-specified part count. Such designs easily lead to overfitting, fragmented or missing structural components, and limited compositional generalization when encountering novel object layouts. To this end, this paper rethinks single-image 3D generation as learning an adaptive part-whole hierarchy in the flexible 3D latent space. We present a novel part-to-whole 3D generative world model that autonomously discovers latent structural slots by inferring soft and compositional masks directly from image tokens. Specifically, an adaptive slot-gating mechanism dynamically determines the slot-wise activation probabilities and smoothly consolidates redundant slots within different objects, ensuring that the emergent structure remains compact yet expressive across categories. Each distilled slot is then aligned to a learnable, class-agnostic prototype bank, enabling powerful cross-category shape sharing and denoising through universal geometric prototypes in the real world. Furthermore, a lightweight 3D denoiser is introduced to reconstruct geometry and appearance via unified diffusion objectives. Experiments show consistent gains in cross-category transfer and part-count extrapolation, and ablations confirm complementary benefits of the prototype bank for shape-prior sharing as well as slot-gating for structural adaptation.
tldr: This paper introduces a novel 3D generative world model that learns an adaptive part-whole hierarchy from single images by autonomosly discovering latent structural slots. It enables cross-category shape sharing and denoising using a class-agnostic prototype bank and a lightweight 3D denoiser.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的3D生成世界模型，通过自主发现潜在的结构槽位，从单张图像中学习自适应的部分-整体层次结构。它利用类别无关的原型库和一个轻量级的3D降噪器，实现了跨类别的形状共享和降噪。
summary_zh: 单图像3D生成是现实世界中视觉到图形模型的关键。然而，在稀疏监督下，实现跨各种语义类别和高度可变结构复杂性的可靠泛化仍然是一个根本性的挑战。现有的方法通常以整体的方式对对象进行建模，或者依赖于固定数量的部件，包括最近的部件感知模型，如PartCrafter，它们仍然需要人工指定部件数量这一耗时操作。这种设计容易导致过拟合、结构组件的碎片化或缺失，以及在遇到新的对象布局时，组合泛化的能力受限。为此，本文将单图像3D生成重新思考为在灵活的3D潜在空间中学习自适应的部件-整体层次结构。我们提出了一种新颖的部件到整体的3D生成世界模型，该模型通过直接从图像令牌中推断软组合掩码来自主地发现潜在的结构槽。具体来说，一种自适应槽门控机制动态地确定槽级别的激活概率，并平滑地整合不同对象中冗余的槽，确保涌现的结构在类别之间保持紧凑而富有表现力。每个提取出的槽随后与一个可学习的、类别无关的原型库对齐，从而通过现实世界中的通用几何原型实现强大的跨类别形状共享和去噪。此外，引入了一个轻量级的3D去噪器，通过统一的扩散目标来重建几何形状和外观。实验表明，在跨类别迁移和部件数量外推方面取得了持续的提升，并且消融实验证实了原型库对于形状先验共享以及槽门控对于结构自适应的互补优势。

title: Learning Trajectory-Aware Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Reasoning Segmentation
summary: The prosperity of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has stimulated the demand for video reasoning segmentation, which aims to segment video objects based on human instructions. Previous studies rely on unidirectional and implicit text-trajectory alignment, which struggles with trajectory perception when faced with severe video dynamics. In this work, we propose TrajSeg, a simple and unified framework built upon MLLMs. Concretely, we introduce bidirectional text-trajectory alignment, where MLLMs accept grounding-intended (text-to-trajectory) and captioning-intended (trajectory-to-text) instructions. This way, MLLMs can benefit from enhanced correspondence and better perceive object trajectories in videos. The mask generation from trajectories is achieved via a frame-level content integration (FCI) module and a unified mask decoder. The former adapts the MLLM-parsed trajectory-level token to frame-specific information. The latter unifies segmentation for all frames into a single structure, enabling the proposed framework to be simplified and end-to-end trainable. Extensive experiments on referring and reasoning video segmentation datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of TrajSeg, which outperforms all video reasoning segmentation methods on all metrics. The code will be publicly available at https://github.com/haodi19/TrajSeg.
tldr: The paper introduces TrajSeg, a new MLLM-based framework for video reasoning segmentation using bidirectional text-trajectory alignment to improve performance on dynamic videos, achieving state-of-the-art results.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TrajSeg，一种新的基于MLLM的视频推理分割框架，它使用双向文本-轨迹对齐来提高在动态视频上的性能，并取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）的繁荣刺激了对视频推理分割的需求，旨在根据人类指令分割视频对象。以往研究依赖于单向且隐式的文本-轨迹对齐，在面对剧烈的视频动态时难以感知轨迹。本文提出 TrajSeg，一个构建于 MLLMs 之上的简单而统一的框架。具体而言，我们引入了双向文本-轨迹对齐，其中 MLLMs 接收面向定位（文本到轨迹）和面向描述（轨迹到文本）的指令。通过这种方式，MLLMs 可以从增强的对应关系中受益，并更好地感知视频中的对象轨迹。轨迹到掩码的生成通过帧级内容集成（FCI）模块和统一掩码解码器实现。前者使 MLLM 解析的轨迹级标记适应于帧特定的信息。后者将所有帧的分割统一到一个单一结构中，从而简化了所提出的框架并使其能够端到端训练。在指代和推理视频分割数据集上的大量实验证明了 TrajSeg 的有效性，其在所有指标上都优于所有视频推理分割方法。代码将在 https://github.com/haodi19/TrajSeg 公开。

title: Causal Evidence that Language Models use Confidence to Drive Behavior
summary: Metacognition -- the ability to assess one's own cognitive performance -- is documented across species, with internal confidence estimates serving as a key signal for adaptive behavior. While confidence can be extracted from Large Language Model (LLM) outputs, whether models actively use these signals to regulate behavior remains a fundamental question. We investigate this through a four-phase abstention paradigm.Phase 1 established internal confidence estimates in the absence of an abstention option. Phase 2 revealed that LLMs apply implicit thresholds to these estimates when deciding to answer or abstain. Confidence emerged as the dominant predictor of behavior, with effect sizes an order of magnitude larger than knowledge retrieval accessibility (RAG scores) or surface-level semantic features. Phase 3 provided causal evidence through activation steering: manipulating internal confidence signals correspondingly shifted abstention rates. Finally, Phase 4 demonstrated that models can systematically vary abstention policies based on instructed thresholds.Our findings indicate that abstention arises from the joint operation of internal confidence representations and threshold-based policies, mirroring the two-stage metacognitive control found in biological systems. This capacity is essential as LLMs transition into autonomous agents that must recognize their own uncertainty to decide when to act or seek help.
tldr: This paper demonstrates that Large Language Models (LLMs) actively use internal confidence estimates to regulate their behavior, specifically in deciding when to abstain from answering, similar to metacognitive control in biological systems.
tldr_zh: 本文证明了大型语言模型（LLM）主动使用内部置信度估计来调节其行为，特别是在决定何时避免回答时，类似于生物系统中的元认知控制。
summary_zh: 元认知——评估自身认知表现的能力——已被记录在多个物种中，内部置信度估计是适应性行为的关键信号。尽管置信度可以从大型语言模型（LLM）的输出中提取，但模型是否主动利用这些信号来调节行为仍然是一个根本问题。我们通过一个四阶段的弃权范式对此进行研究。第一阶段确立了在没有弃权选项的情况下的内部置信度估计。第二阶段揭示了LLM在决定回答或弃权时，会对这些估计应用隐式阈值。置信度成为行为的主导预测因子，其效应量比知识检索可访问性（RAG分数）或表面语义特征大一个数量级。第三阶段通过激活操控提供了因果证据：操纵内部置信度信号会相应地改变弃权率。最后，第四阶段证明了模型可以根据指示的阈值系统地改变弃权策略。我们的研究结果表明，弃权的产生源于内部置信度表示和基于阈值的策略的联合运作，这与生物系统中发现的两阶段元认知控制相呼应。这种能力至关重要，因为LLM正在过渡为必须识别自身不确定性才能决定何时行动或寻求帮助的自主智能体。

title: Demystifying Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents: A Comprehensive Recipe
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is essential for evolving Large Language Models (LLMs) into autonomous agents capable of long-horizon planning, yet a practical recipe for scaling RL in complex, multi-turn environments remains elusive. This paper presents a systematic empirical study using TravelPlanner, a challenging testbed requiring tool orchestration to satisfy multifaceted constraints. We decompose the agentic RL design space along 5 axes: reward shaping, model scaling, data composition, algorithm selection, and environmental stability. Our controlled experiments yield 7 key takeaways, e.g., (1) reward and algorithm choices are scale-dependent as smaller models benefit from staged rewards and enhanced exploration, whereas larger models converge efficiently with simpler dense rewards, (2) ~ 1K training samples with a balanced difficulty mixture mark a sweet spot for both in-domain and out-of-domain performance, and (3) environmental stability is critical to prevent policy degradation. Based on our distilled recipe, our RL-trained models achieve state-of-the-art performance on TravelPlanner, significantly outperforming leading LLMs.
tldr: This paper presents a systematic study on using Reinforcement Learning to train LLMs for long-horizon tool-using tasks in the TravelPlanner environment, deriving a practical recipe and achieving state-of-the-art performance.
tldr_zh: 本文系统地研究了使用强化学习训练LLM以完成TravelPlanner环境中长期的工具使用任务，得出了一个实用的方案，并实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 强化学习(RL)对于将大型语言模型(LLMs)发展为能够进行长程规划的自主Agent至关重要，但在复杂、多轮环境中扩展RL的实用方法仍然难以捉摸。本文使用TravelPlanner进行了一项系统的实证研究，这是一个具有挑战性的测试平台，需要工具编排来满足多方面的约束。我们将Agent型RL的设计空间分解为5个维度：奖励塑造、模型规模、数据构成、算法选择和环境稳定性。我们的受控实验产生了7个关键结论，例如，(1)奖励和算法的选择依赖于规模，因为较小的模型受益于分阶段的奖励和增强的探索，而较大的模型在更简单的密集奖励下能够高效收敛，(2)约1K个训练样本，包含平衡的难度混合，是领域内和领域外性能的甜蜜点，以及(3)环境稳定性对于防止策略退化至关重要。基于我们提炼的方法，我们经过RL训练的模型在TravelPlanner上实现了最先进的性能，显著优于领先的LLMs。

title: DRTriton: Large-Scale Synthetic Data Reinforcement Learning for Triton Kernel Generation
summary: Developing efficient CUDA kernels is a fundamental yet challenging task in the generative AI industry. Recent researches leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically convert PyTorch reference implementations to CUDA kernels, significantly reducing the engineering efforts. State-of-the-art LLMs, such as GPT-5.2 and Claude-Sonnet-4.5, still struggle in this specific task. To address this challenge, we propose DRTriton, a scalable learning framework for training LLMs to convert PyTorch codes into highly optimized Triton kernels, which are then compiled to CUDA kernels at runtime. DRTriton consists of three key components: (i) a data synthetic algorithm CSP-DAG that guarantees full coverage and unbiased uniform sampling over the operator space with controlled difficulty; (ii) a curriculum reinforcement learning with decoupled reward efficiently optimizes conversion success rate and inference speed simultaneously; and (iii) a test-time search algorithm that further improves the inference speed of the generated Triton kernels. Notably, despite being trained exclusively on synthetic data, DRTriton generalizes effectively to real-world CUDA kernels that are challenging even for human experts. Experimental results show that DRTriton-7B achieves speedup on 92% of the KernelBench Level 2, compared to 23% for GPT-5.2 and 19% for Claude-Sonnet-4.5.
tldr: DRTriton is a reinforcement learning framework using synthetic data to train LLMs for converting PyTorch code to optimized Triton/CUDA kernels, achieving significant speedups compared to existing LLMs.
tldr_zh: DRTriton是一个强化学习框架，使用合成数据训练LLM，用于将PyTorch代码转换为优化的Triton/CUDA内核，与现有LLM相比实现了显著的加速。
summary_zh: 在生成式人工智能产业中，开发高效的 CUDA 内核是一项基础但充满挑战的任务。 近期研究利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 自动将 PyTorch 参考实现转换成 CUDA 内核，从而显著减少工程投入。 诸如 GPT-5.2 和 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 等最先进的 LLM 在这项特定任务中仍然表现不佳。 为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了 DRTriton，一个可扩展的学习框架，用于训练 LLM 将 PyTorch 代码转换成高度优化的 Triton 内核，这些内核随后在运行时编译成 CUDA 内核。 DRTriton 包含三个关键组件：(i) 数据合成算法 CSP-DAG，保证在算子空间上实现全面覆盖和无偏均匀抽样，同时控制难度； (ii) 基于解耦奖励的课程强化学习，能够同时高效地优化转换成功率和推理速度；(iii) 一种测试时搜索算法，进一步提升生成的 Triton 内核的推理速度。 值得注意的是，尽管完全基于合成数据进行训练，DRTriton 能够有效地泛化到现实世界的 CUDA 内核，这些内核即使对人类专家来说也充满挑战。 实验结果表明，与 GPT-5.2 的 23% 和 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 的 19% 相比，DRTriton-7B 在 KernelBench Level 2 上实现了 92% 的加速。

title: Make Tracking Easy: Neural Motion Retargeting for Humanoid Whole-body Control
summary: Humanoid robots require diverse motor skills to integrate into complex environments, but bridging the kinematic and dynamic embodiment gap from human data remains a major bottleneck. We demonstrate through Hessian analysis that traditional optimization-based retargeting is inherently non-convex and prone to local optima, leading to physical artifacts like joint jumps and self-penetration. To address this, we reformulate the targeting problem as learning data distribution rather than optimizing optimal solutions, where we propose NMR, a Neural Motion Retargeting framework that transforms static geometric mapping into a dynamics-aware learned process. We first propose Clustered-Expert Physics Refinement (CEPR), a hierarchical data pipeline that leverages VAE-based motion clustering to group heterogeneous movements into latent motifs. This strategy significantly reduces the computational overhead of massively parallel reinforcement learning experts, which project and repair noisy human demonstrations onto the robot's feasible motion manifold. The resulting high-fidelity data supervises a non-autoregressive CNN-Transformer architecture that reasons over global temporal context to suppress reconstruction noise and bypass geometric traps. Experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid across diverse dynamic tasks (e.g., martial arts, dancing) show that NMR eliminates joint jumps and significantly reduces self-collisions compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, NMR-generated references accelerate the convergence of downstream whole-body control policies, establishing a scalable path for bridging the human-robot embodiment gap.
tldr: The paper introduces Neural Motion Retargeting (NMR), a framework leveraging clustered-expert physics refinement and a CNN-Transformer architecture to transfer human motion to humanoid robots, addressing issues like joint jumps and self-collisions in traditional optimization-based methods. It shows improved performance on a Unitree G1 humanoid.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种神经运动重定向 (NMR) 框架，利用聚类专家物理细化和 CNN-Transformer 架构将人类运动转移到人形机器人，解决了传统优化方法中存在的关节跳跃和自碰撞等问题。实验表明，该方法在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上表现出更好的性能。
summary_zh: 人形机器人需要多种运动技能才能融入复杂环境，但弥合人类数据中运动学和动力学体现之间的差距仍然是一个主要瓶颈。我们通过黑塞矩阵分析证明，传统的基于优化的重定向方法本质上是非凸的，并且容易陷入局部最优，从而导致关节跳动和自穿透等物理伪影。为了解决这个问题，我们将目标问题重新定义为学习数据分布，而不是优化最优解，并提出了NMR，一种神经运动重定向框架，它将静态几何映射转换为一种具有动力感知的学习过程。我们首先提出了聚类专家物理细化（CEPR），一种分层数据管道，利用基于VAE的运动聚类将异构运动分组为潜在主题。这种策略显著减少了大规模并行强化学习专家的计算开销，这些专家将嘈杂的人类演示投影并修复到机器人的可行运动流形上。由此产生的高保真数据监督一种非自回归的CNN-Transformer架构，该架构能够推理全局时间上下文，从而抑制重建噪声并绕过几何陷阱。在宇树G1人形机器人上进行的各种动态任务（例如，武术、舞蹈）实验表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，NMR消除了关节跳动并显著减少了自碰撞。此外，NMR生成的参考加速了下游全身控制策略的收敛，为弥合人机体现差距建立了一条可扩展的路径。

title: Programming Manufacturing Robots with Imperfect AI: LLMs as Tuning Experts for FDM Print Configuration Selection
summary: We use fused deposition modeling (FDM) 3D printing as a case study of how manufacturing robots can use imperfect AI to acquire process expertise. In FDM, print configuration strongly affects output quality. Yet, novice users typically rely on default configurations, trial-and-error, or recommendations from generic AI models (e.g., ChatGPT). These strategies can produce complete prints, but they do not reliably meet specific objectives. Experts iteratively tune print configurations using evidence from prior prints. We present a modular closed-loop approach that treats an LLM as a source of tuning expertise. We embed this source of expertise within a Bayesian optimization loop. An approximate evaluator scores each print configuration and returns structured diagnostics, which the LLM uses to propose natural-language adjustments that are compiled into machine-actionable guidance for optimization. On 100 Thingi10k parts, our LLM-guided loop achieves the best configuration on 78% objects with 0% likely-to-fail cases, while single-shot AI model recommendations are rarely best and exhibit 15% likely-to-fail cases. These results suggest that LLMs provide more value as constrained decision modules in evidence-driven optimization loops than as end-to-end oracles for print configuration selection. We expect this result to extend to broader LLM-based robot programming.
tldr: The paper presents a method for using LLMs as 'tuning experts' within a Bayesian optimization loop for FDM 3D printing, showing improved configuration selection compared to single-shot AI recommendations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用LLM作为“调优专家”的方法，将其置于贝叶斯优化循环中用于FDM 3D打印，结果表明与一次性AI推荐相比，配置选择得到了改进。
summary_zh: 我们以熔融沉积成型(FDM) 3D打印为例，研究制造机器人如何利用不完善的AI来获取工艺专业知识。在FDM中，打印配置对输出质量有很大影响。然而，新手用户通常依赖默认配置、试错法或来自通用AI模型（例如ChatGPT）的建议。这些策略可以生成完整的打印件，但无法可靠地满足特定目标。专家们会使用先前打印件的证据迭代地调整打印配置。我们提出了一种模块化的闭环方法，将LLM视为调优专业知识的来源。我们将这种专业知识来源嵌入到贝叶斯优化循环中。一个近似评估器对每个打印配置进行评分，并返回结构化的诊断信息，LLM使用这些信息提出自然语言调整建议，这些建议被编译为可由机器执行的优化指导。在100个Thingi10k零件上，我们的LLM引导的循环在78%的对象上实现了最佳配置，且可能失败的情况为0%，而单次AI模型推荐很少能达到最佳，并且可能失败的情况高达15%。这些结果表明，在证据驱动的优化循环中，LLM作为受约束的决策模块比作为打印配置选择的端到端预言机更有价值。我们预计这一结果将推广到更广泛的基于LLM的机器人编程。

title: RAFL: Generalizable Sim-to-Real of Soft Robots with Residual Acceleration Field Learning
summary:
Differentiable simulators enable gradient-based optimization of soft robots over material parameters, control, and morphology, but accurately modeling real systems remains challenging due to the sim-to-real gap. This issue becomes more pronounced when geometry is itself a design variable. System identification reduces discrepancies by fitting global material parameters to data; however, when constitutive models are misspecified or observations are sparse, identified parameters often absorb geometry-dependent effects rather than reflect intrinsic material behavior. More expressive constitutive models can improve accuracy but substantially increase computational cost, limiting practicality.
  We propose a residual acceleration field learning (RAFL) framework that augments a base simulator with a transferable, element-level corrective dynamics field. Operating on shared local features, the model is agnostic to global mesh topology and discretization. Trained end-to-end through a differentiable simulator using sparse marker observations, the learned residual generalizes across shapes. In both sim-to-sim and sim-to-real experiments, our method achieves consistent zero-shot improvements on unseen morphologies, while system identification frequently exhibits negative transfer. The framework also supports continual refinement, enabling simulation accuracy to accumulate during morphology optimization.
tldr: The paper introduces Residual Acceleration Field Learning (RAFL) to improve sim-to-real transfer for soft robots by learning a corrective dynamics field, showing zero-shot improvements on unseen morphologies.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了残差加速度场学习 (RAFL)，通过学习一个校正动力学场来提高软机器人的 sim-to-real 迁移，并在未见过的形态上显示出零样本改进。
summary_zh:
可微分模拟器能够基于梯度优化软机器人的材料参数、控制和形态，但由于模拟到真实世界的差距，对真实系统进行精确建模仍然具有挑战性。当几何形状本身成为设计变量时，这个问题变得更加明显。系统辨识通过拟合全局材料参数来减少差异；然而，当本构模型被错误指定或观测稀疏时，辨识出的参数往往吸收了与几何形状相关的效应，而不是反映内在的材料行为。更具表现力的本构模型可以提高精度，但会显著增加计算成本，从而限制了实用性。

我们提出了一种残差加速度场学习 (RAFL) 框架，该框架通过一种可迁移的、元素级别的校正动力学场来增强基础模拟器。该模型基于共享的局部特征运行，与全局网格拓扑结构和离散化无关。通过可微分模拟器和稀疏标记点观测进行端到端训练，学习到的残差可以推广到不同的形状。在模拟到模拟和模拟到真实世界的实验中，我们的方法在未见过的形态上实现了持续的零样本改进，而系统辨识经常表现出负迁移。该框架还支持持续细化，从而使仿真精度能够在形态优化过程中不断积累。

title: MEVIUS2: Practical Open-Source Quadruped Robot with Sheet Metal Welding and Multimodal Perception
summary: Various quadruped robots have been developed to date, and thanks to reinforcement learning, they are now capable of traversing diverse types of rough terrain. In parallel, there is a growing trend of releasing these robot designs as open-source, enabling researchers to freely build and modify robots themselves. However, most existing open-source quadruped robots have been designed with 3D printing in mind, resulting in structurally fragile systems that do not scale well in size, leading to the construction of relatively small robots. Although a few open-source quadruped robots constructed with metal components exist, they still tend to be small in size and lack multimodal sensors for perception, making them less practical. In this study, we developed MEVIUS2, an open-source quadruped robot with a size comparable to Boston Dynamics' Spot, whose structural components can all be ordered through e-commerce services. By leveraging sheet metal welding and metal machining, we achieved a large, highly durable body structure while reducing the number of individual parts. Furthermore, by integrating sensors such as LiDARs and a high dynamic range camera, the robot is capable of detailed perception of its surroundings, making it more practical than previous open-source quadruped robots. We experimentally validated that MEVIUS2 can traverse various types of rough terrain and demonstrated its environmental perception capabilities. All hardware, software, and training environments can be obtained from Supplementary Materials or https://github.com/haraduka/mevius2.
tldr: The paper introduces MEVIUS2, a practical, open-source, large-scale quadruped robot built using sheet metal welding, featuring multimodal perception and demonstrated rough terrain traversal capabilities.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍MEVIUS2，一个实用的、开源的、大型四足机器人，采用钣金焊接制造，具有多模态感知能力，并展示了其在粗糙地形上的运动能力。
summary_zh: 迄今为止，已经开发出各种四足机器人，并且得益于强化学习，它们现在能够在各种类型的崎岖地形上穿行。与此同时，将这些机器人设计作为开源发布的趋势日益增长，使得研究人员能够自由地构建和修改机器人。然而，大多数现有的开源四足机器人在设计时都考虑到了3D打印，导致结构脆弱，且在尺寸方面无法很好地扩展，最终只能构建相对较小的机器人。尽管存在少数用金属部件构建的开源四足机器人，但它们通常尺寸仍然较小，并且缺乏用于感知的多模态传感器，使其不太实用。在本研究中，我们开发了MEVIUS2，一款尺寸与波士顿动力公司的Spot相当的开源四足机器人，其结构部件都可以通过电子商务服务订购。通过利用钣金焊接和金属加工，我们实现了大型、高度耐用的机身结构，同时减少了单个零件的数量。此外，通过集成诸如激光雷达和高动态范围相机之类的传感器，该机器人能够对其周围环境进行详细感知，使其比以前的开源四足机器人更具实用性。我们通过实验验证了MEVIUS2可以穿越各种类型的崎岖地形，并展示了其环境感知能力。所有硬件、软件和训练环境都可以从Supplementary Materials或https://github.com/haraduka/mevius2获取。

title: Sim-to-Real of Humanoid Locomotion Policies via Joint Torque Space Perturbation Injection
summary: This paper proposes a novel alternative to existing sim-to-real methods for training control policies with simulated experiences. Unlike prior methods that typically rely on domain randomization over a fixed finite set of parameters, the proposed approach injects state-dependent perturbations into the input joint torque during forward simulation. These perturbations are designed to simulate a broader spectrum of reality gaps than standard parameter randomization without requiring additional training. By using neural networks as flexible perturbation generators, the proposed method can represent complex, state-dependent uncertainties, such as nonlinear actuator dynamics and contact compliance, that parametric randomization cannot capture. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach enables humanoid locomotion policies to achieve superior robustness against complex, unseen reality gaps in both simulation and real-world deployment.
tldr: This paper introduces a novel sim-to-real method for humanoid locomotion by injecting state-dependent joint torque perturbations during simulation, achieving robust real-world performance without requiring extensive domain randomization or retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的类人机器人运动仿真到现实的方法，通过在仿真过程中注入与状态相关的关节力矩扰动，实现了鲁棒的真实世界性能，而无需大量的领域随机化或重新训练。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种训练控制策略的新颖方法，用于替代现有的基于模拟到真实（sim-to-real）的方法。与通常依赖于对固定的有限参数集进行域随机化的现有方法不同，所提出的方法在正向仿真过程中将状态相关的扰动注入到输入关节力矩中。这些扰动旨在模拟比标准参数随机化更广泛的现实差异，而无需额外的训练。通过使用神经网络作为灵活的扰动生成器，该方法可以表示复杂的、状态相关的不确定性，例如参数随机化无法捕捉到的非线性执行器动力学和接触柔顺性。实验结果表明，所提出的方法使人形机器人运动策略能够在模拟和真实世界部署中，针对复杂的、未知的现实差异实现卓越的鲁棒性。

title: Directional Mollification for Controlled Smooth Path Generation
summary: Path generation, the problem of producing smooth, executable paths from discrete planning outputs, such as waypoint sequences, is a fundamental step in the control of autonomous robots, industrial robots, and CNC machines, as path following and trajectory tracking controllers impose strict differentiability requirements on their reference inputs to guarantee stability and convergence, particularly for nonholonomic systems. Mollification has been recently proposed as a computationally efficient and analytically tractable tool for path generation, offering formal smoothness and curvature guarantees with advantages over spline interpolation and optimization-based methods. However, this mollification is subject to a fundamental geometric constraint: the smoothed path is confined within the convex hull of the original path, precluding exact waypoint interpolation, even when explicitly required by mission specifications or upstream planners. We introduce directional mollification, a novel operator that resolves this limitation while retaining the analytical tractability of classical mollification. The proposed operator generates infinitely differentiable paths that strictly interpolate prescribed waypoints, converge to the original non-differentiable input with arbitrary precision, and satisfy explicit curvature bounds given by a closed-form expression, addressing the core requirements of path generation for controlled autonomous systems. We further establish a parametric family of path generation operators that contains both classical and directional mollification as special cases, providing a unifying theoretical framework for the systematic generation of smooth, feasible paths from non-differentiable planning outputs.
tldr: The paper introduces 'directional mollification,' a new path generation operator that creates smooth, waypoint-interpolating paths with curvature bounds, addressing limitations of classical mollification for robot control.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种名为“方向磨光”的新型路径生成算子，该算子可以创建具有曲率边界的平滑、航路点插值路径，从而解决了经典磨光在机器人控制方面的局限性。
summary_zh: 路径生成，即从离散的规划输出（如航路点序列）生成平滑、可执行路径的问题，是自主机器人、工业机器人和数控机床控制中的一个基本步骤。由于路径跟踪和轨迹跟踪控制器对其参考输入施加严格的可微性要求，以保证稳定性和收敛性，特别是对于非完整系统而言。软化（Mollification）最近被提出作为一种在路径生成中计算高效且解析可处理的工具，相比于样条插值和基于优化的方法，它能够提供形式化的平滑性和曲率担保。然而，这种软化受到一个基本的几何约束的限制：平滑后的路径被限制在原始路径的凸包内，从而排除了精确的航路点插值，即使任务规范或上游规划器明确要求这样做。我们引入了方向软化（directional mollification），这是一种新颖的算子，它解决了这一局限性，同时保留了经典软化的解析可处理性。所提出的算子生成无限可微的路径，严格插值预先指定的航路点，以任意精度收敛于原始的不可微输入，并满足由闭合形式表达式给出的显式曲率界限，从而满足了受控自主系统路径生成的核心要求。我们进一步建立了一个路径生成算子的参数化族，其中包含经典软化和方向软化作为特殊情况，为从不可微的规划输出中系统地生成平滑、可行路径提供了一个统一的理论框架。

title: Partial Attention in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Safe Multi-Agent Control
summary: Attention mechanisms excel at learning sequential patterns by discriminating data based on relevance and importance. This provides state-of-the-art performance in advanced generative artificial intelligence models. This paper applies this concept of an attention mechanism for multi-agent safe control. We specifically consider the design of a neural network to control autonomous vehicles in a highway merging scenario. The environment is modeled as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP). Within a QMIX framework, we include partial attention for each autonomous vehicle, thus allowing each ego vehicle to focus on the most relevant neighboring vehicles. Moreover, we propose a comprehensive reward signal that considers the global objectives of the environment (e.g., safety and vehicle flow) and the individual interests of each agent. Simulations are conducted in the Simulation of Urban Mobility (SUMO). The results show better performance compared to other driving algorithms in terms of safety, driving speed, and reward.
tldr: This paper introduces a partial attention mechanism within a QMIX framework for safe multi-agent control of autonomous vehicles in a highway merging scenario, demonstrating improved performance in safety, speed, and reward in SUMO simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在QMIX框架内的部分注意力机制，用于高速公路并线场景中自动驾驶汽车的安全多智能体控制。SUMO模拟结果表明，该方法在安全性、速度和奖励方面均有提高。
summary_zh: 注意力机制通过基于相关性和重要性区分数据，擅长学习序列模式。这为先进的生成式人工智能模型提供了最先进的性能。本文将注意力机制的概念应用于多智能体安全控制。我们特别考虑设计一种神经网络来控制高速公路汇流场景中的自动驾驶车辆。该环境被建模为分散式部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP）。在QMIX框架内，我们为每个自动驾驶车辆引入部分注意力，从而允许每个自车关注最相关的邻近车辆。此外，我们提出了一种综合奖励信号，考虑了环境的全局目标（例如，安全和车辆流量）和每个智能体的个体利益。在城市交通仿真（SUMO）中进行了仿真。结果表明，与其他驾驶算法相比，在安全性、行驶速度和奖励方面表现更好。

title: BiPreManip: Learning Affordance-Based Bimanual Preparatory Manipulation through Anticipatory Collaboration
summary: Many everyday objects are difficult to directly grasp (e.g., a flat iPad) or manipulate functionally (e.g., opening the cap of a pen lying on a desk). Such tasks require sequential, asymmetric coordination between two arms, where one arm performs preparatory manipulation that enables the other's goal-directed action - for instance, pushing the iPad to the table's edge before picking it up, or lifting the pen body to allow the other hand to remove its cap. In this work, we introduce Collaborative Preparatory Manipulation, a class of bimanual manipulation tasks that demand understanding object semantics and geometry, anticipating spatial relationships, and planning long-horizon coordinated actions between the two arms. To tackle this challenge, we propose a visual affordance-based framework that first envisions the final goal-directed action and then guides one arm to perform a sequence of preparatory manipulations that facilitate the other arm's subsequent operation. This affordance-centric representation enables anticipatory inter-arm reasoning and coordination, generalizing effectively across various objects spanning diverse categories. Extensive experiments in both simulation and the real world demonstrate that our approach substantially improves task success rates and generalization compared to competitive baselines.
tldr: The paper introduces a framework for bimanual robotic manipulation that uses visual affordances to enable preparatory actions by one arm to facilitate goal-directed actions by the other, demonstrating improved success rates and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种双臂机器人操作框架，该框架使用视觉可供性来实现一个手臂的预备动作，以帮助另一手臂完成有目标导向的动作，从而提高了成功率和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 许多日常物品难以直接抓取（例如，扁平的iPad）或进行功能性操作（例如，打开桌上笔的笔帽）。这类任务需要双臂之间的顺序、非对称协调，其中一只手臂执行准备性操作，以使另一只手臂执行目标导向动作——例如，将iPad推到桌子边缘后再拿起，或抬起笔身以允许另一只手取下笔帽。在这项工作中，我们介绍了协同准备性操作，这是一类双手动操作任务，其要求理解物体语义和几何属性、预测空间关系，以及规划双臂之间的长时程协调动作。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于视觉可供性的框架，该框架首先设想最终的目标导向动作，然后引导一只手臂执行一系列准备性操作，从而促进另一只手臂的后续操作。这种以可供性为中心的表示方法能够实现预测性的臂间推理和协调，并在跨越不同类别的各种物体中有效地泛化。在模拟和真实世界中的大量实验表明，与具有竞争力的基线方法相比，我们的方法显著提高了任务成功率和泛化能力。

title: Conformal Koopman for Embedded Nonlinear Control with Statistical Robustness: Theory and Real-World Validation
summary: We propose a fully data-driven, Koopman-based framework for statistically robust control of discrete-time nonlinear systems with linear embeddings. Establishing a connection between the Koopman operator and contraction theory, it offers distribution-free probabilistic bounds on the state tracking error under Koopman modeling uncertainty. Conformal prediction is employed here to rigorously derive a bound on the state-dependent modeling uncertainty throughout the trajectory, ensuring safety and robustness without assuming a specific error prediction structure or distribution. Unlike prior approaches that merely combine conformal prediction with Koopman-based control in an open-loop setting, our method establishes a closed-loop control architecture with formal guarantees that explicitly account for both forward and inverse modeling errors. Also, by expressing the tracking error bound in terms of the control parameters and the modeling errors, our framework offers a quantitative means to formally enhance the performance of arbitrary Koopman-based control. We validate our method both in numerical simulations with the Dubins car and in real-world experiments with a highly nonlinear flapping-wing drone. The results demonstrate that our method indeed provides formal safety guarantees while maintaining accurate tracking performance under Koopman modeling uncertainty.
tldr: This paper presents a data-driven Koopman-based control framework for nonlinear systems with statistical robustness guarantees, validated through simulations and real-world experiments on a flapping-wing drone.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于Koopman算子的数据驱动控制框架，用于具有统计鲁棒性的非线性系统。该方法通过仿真和实际的拍翼无人机实验进行了验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种完全数据驱动的、基于Koopman算子的框架，用于对具有线性嵌入的离散时间非线性系统进行统计鲁棒控制。通过建立Koopman算子与压缩理论之间的联系，该框架提供了在Koopman建模不确定性下状态跟踪误差的无分布概率边界。这里采用共形预测来严格推导整个轨迹上与状态相关的建模不确定性的边界，从而在不假设特定误差预测结构或分布的情况下确保安全性和鲁棒性。与先前仅将共形预测与基于Koopman的控制在开环环境中相结合的方法不同，我们的方法建立了一个闭环控制架构，该架构具有正式保证，能够显式地考虑正向和逆向建模误差。此外，通过根据控制参数和建模误差来表达跟踪误差边界，我们的框架提供了一种定量方法来正式地增强任意基于Koopman的控制的性能。我们在Dubins车的数值模拟以及高度非线性的拍翼无人机的真实世界实验中验证了我们的方法。结果表明，我们的方法确实提供了正式的安全保证，同时在Koopman建模不确定性下保持了准确的跟踪性能。

title: CataractSAM-2: A Domain-Adapted Model for Anterior Segment Surgery Segmentation and Scalable Ground-Truth Annotation
summary: We present CataractSAM-2, a domain-adapted extension of Meta's Segment Anything Model 2, designed for real-time semantic segmentation of cataract ophthalmic surgery videos with high accuracy. Positioned at the intersection of computer vision and medical robotics, CataractSAM-2 enables precise intraoperative perception crucial for robotic-assisted and computer-guided surgical systems. Furthermore, to alleviate the burden of manual labeling, we introduce an interactive annotation framework that combines sparse prompts with video-based mask propagation. This tool significantly reduces annotation time and facilitates the scalable creation of high-quality ground-truth masks, accelerating dataset development for ocular anterior segment surgeries. We also demonstrate the model's strong zero-shot generalization to glaucoma trabeculectomy procedures, confirming its cross-procedural utility and potential for broader surgical applications. The trained model and annotation toolkit are released as open-source resources, establishing CataractSAM-2 as a foundation for expanding anterior ophthalmic surgical datasets and advancing real-time AI-driven solutions in medical robotics, as well as surgical video understanding.
tldr: CataractSAM-2, a domain-adapted SAM, is presented for real-time cataract surgery video segmentation, along with an efficient annotation tool, showing zero-shot generalization to other procedures and released as open-source.
tldr_zh: CataractSAM-2是一个针对白内障手术视频实时分割的领域自适应SAM模型,  kèm theo một công cụ chú thích hiệu quả, 展示了对其他手术的零样本泛化能力, 并已开源发布。
summary_zh: 我们提出了CataractSAM-2，Meta Segment Anything Model 2的领域自适应扩展，旨在以高精度对白内障眼科手术视频进行实时语义分割。CataractSAM-2定位于计算机视觉与医疗机器人的交叉领域，能够实现术中精准感知，这对于机器人辅助和计算机引导的手术系统至关重要。此外，为了减轻手动标注的负担，我们引入了一种交互式标注框架，该框架将稀疏提示与基于视频的掩膜传播相结合。该工具显著减少了标注时间，并促进了高质量 ground-truth 掩膜的可扩展创建，从而加速了眼前节手术数据集的开发。我们还展示了该模型对青光眼小梁切除术的强大零样本泛化能力，证实了其跨手术程序的实用性以及在更广泛的外科应用中的潜力。训练好的模型和标注工具以开源资源的形式发布，将CataractSAM-2确立为扩展眼前节眼科手术数据集以及推进医疗机器人和手术视频理解中实时AI驱动解决方案的基础。

title: A Framework for Closed-Loop Robotic Assembly, Alignment and Self-Recovery of Precision Optical Systems
summary: Robotic automation has transformed scientific workflows in domains such as chemistry and materials science, yet free-space optics, which is a high precision domain, remains largely manual. Optical systems impose strict spatial and angular tolerances, and their performance is governed by tightly coupled physical parameters, making generalizable automation particularly challenging. In this work, we present a robotics framework for the autonomous construction, alignment, and maintenance of precision optical systems. Our approach integrates hierarchical computer vision systems, optimization routines, and custom-built tools to achieve this functionality. As a representative demonstration, we perform the fully autonomous construction of a tabletop laser cavity from randomly distributed components. The system performs several tasks such as laser beam centering, spatial alignment of multiple beams, resonator alignment, laser mode selection, and self-recovery from induced misalignment and disturbances. By achieving closed-loop autonomy for highly sensitive optical systems, this work establishes a foundation for autonomous optical experiments for applications across technical domains.
tldr: This paper presents a robotic framework for the autonomous construction, alignment, and maintenance of precision optical systems using computer vision and optimization routines, demonstrating autonomous laser cavity construction.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种机器人框架，该框架利用计算机视觉和优化程序来实现精密光学系统的自主构建、对准和维护，并演示了激光腔的自主构建。
summary_zh: 机器人自动化已经变革了诸如化学和材料科学等领域的科研工作流程，然而，自由空间光学，一个高精度领域，仍然很大程度上依赖人工操作。光学系统具有严格的空间和角度公差，并且其性能受到紧密耦合的物理参数控制，这使得通用自动化极具挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个机器人框架，用于精密光学系统的自主构建、校准和维护。我们的方法集成了分层计算机视觉系统、优化程序以及定制工具来实现这一功能。作为代表性演示，我们执行了从随机分布的组件中完全自主地构建一个桌面激光腔。该系统执行多项任务，例如激光束定心、多个光束的空间对准、谐振腔校准、激光模式选择以及从诱导的错位和扰动中进行自我恢复。通过实现对高度敏感的光学系统的闭环自主控制，这项工作为跨技术领域的自主光学实验奠定了基础。

title: Bayesian Active Object Recognition and 6D Pose Estimation from Multimodal Contact Sensing
summary: We present an active tactile exploration framework for joint object recognition and 6D pose estimation. The proposed method integrates wrist force/torque sensing, GelSight tactile sensing, and free-space constraints within a Bayesian inference framework that maintains a belief over object class and pose during active tactile exploration. By combining contact and non-contact evidence, the framework reduces ambiguity and improves robustness in the joint class-pose estimation problem. To enable efficient inference in the large hypothesis space, we employ a customized particle filter that progressively samples particles based on new observations. The inferred belief is further used to guide active exploration by selecting informative next touches under reachability constraints. For effective data collection, a motion planning and control framework is developed to plan and execute feasible paths for tactile exploration, handle unexpected contacts and GelSight-surface alignment with tactile servoing. We evaluate the framework in simulation and on a Franka Panda robot using 11 YCB objects. Results show that incorporating tactile and free-space information substantially improves recognition and pose estimation accuracy and stability, while reducing the number of action cycles compared with force/torque-only baselines. Code, dataset, and supplementary material will be made available online.
tldr: This paper presents a Bayesian active tactile exploration framework for joint object recognition and 6D pose estimation, integrating multimodal contact sensing (force/torque, GelSight) and free-space constraints to improve accuracy and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个贝叶斯主动触觉探索框架，用于联合物体识别和六自由度姿态估计，集成了多模态接触感知（力/扭矩、GelSight）和自由空间约束，以提高准确性和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种用于联合物体识别和6D姿态估计的主动触觉探索框架。该方法在一个贝叶斯推断框架内集成了腕部力/力矩传感、GelSight触觉传感和自由空间约束，以维持在主动触觉探索期间对物体类别和姿态的置信度。通过结合接触和非接触证据，该框架降低了歧义，并提高了联合类别-姿态估计问题的鲁棒性。为了在大型假设空间中实现高效的推断，我们采用了一种定制的粒子滤波器，该滤波器根据新的观测结果逐步采样粒子。推断出的置信度进一步用于指导主动探索，即在可达性约束下选择信息量丰富的下一次触碰。为了有效的数据采集，我们开发了一个运动规划和控制框架，用于规划和执行用于触觉探索的可行路径，并通过触觉伺服处理意外接触和GelSight表面对齐。我们使用11个YCB物体在仿真和Franka Panda机器人上评估该框架。结果表明，与仅依赖力/力矩的基线相比，结合触觉和自由空间信息显著提高了识别和姿态估计的准确性和稳定性，同时减少了动作循环的次数。代码、数据集和补充材料将在网上公开。

title: Learning When to Act: Interval-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Predictive Temporal Structure
summary: Autonomous agents operating in continuous environments must decide not only what to do, but when to act. We introduce a lightweight adaptive temporal control system that learns the optimal interval between cognitive ticks from experience, replacing ad hoc biologically inspired timers with a principled learned policy. The policy state is augmented with a predictive hyperbolic spread signal (a "curvature signal" shorthand) derived from hyperbolic geometry: the mean pairwise Poincare distance among n sampled futures embedded in the Poincare ball. High spread indicates a branching, uncertain future and drives the agent to act sooner; low spread signals predictability and permits longer rest intervals. We further propose an interval-aware reward that explicitly penalises inefficiency relative to the chosen wait time, correcting a systematic credit-assignment failure of naive outcome-based rewards in timing problems. We additionally introduce a joint spatio-temporal embedding (ATCPG-ST) that concatenates independently normalised state and position projections in the Poincare ball; spatial trajectory divergence provides an independent timing signal unavailable to the state-only variant (ATCPG-SO). This extension raises mean hyperbolic spread (kappa) from 1.88 to 3.37 and yields a further 5.8 percent efficiency gain over the state-only baseline. Ablation experiments across five random seeds demonstrate that (i) learning is the dominant efficiency factor (54.8 percent over no-learning), (ii) hyperbolic spread provides significant complementary gain (26.2 percent over geometry-free control), (iii) the combined system achieves 22.8 percent efficiency over the fixed-interval baseline, and (iv) adding spatial position information to the spread embedding yields an additional 5.8 percent.
tldr: This paper introduces a novel adaptive temporal control system for reinforcement learning that learns optimal action intervals using a predictive curvature signal derived from hyperbolic geometry, leading to significant efficiency gains in continuous environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新的自适应强化学习时间控制系统，该系统通过使用从双曲几何导出的预测曲率信号来学习最佳动作间隔，从而在连续环境中显著提高效率。
summary_zh: 在连续环境中运行的自主体不仅必须决定做什么，还必须决定何时行动。我们引入了一种轻量级的自适应时间控制系统，该系统从经验中学习认知过程之间的最佳间隔，用一种基于原则的学习策略取代了特别的、受生物学启发的计时器。策略状态通过一个预测性的双曲扩散信号（“曲率信号”的简写）增强，该信号来源于双曲几何：嵌入到庞加莱球中的n个采样未来的平均成对庞加莱距离。高扩散表明未来存在分支和不确定性，并促使主体更快地行动；低扩散则表明可预测性，并允许更长的休息间隔。我们进一步提出了一种区间感知奖励，它明确地惩罚相对于所选等待时间的低效率，纠正了在时间问题中基于朴素结果的奖励所存在的系统性信用分配失败。我们还引入了一种联合时空嵌入（ATCPG-ST），它将庞加莱球中独立规范化的状态和位置投影连接起来；空间轨迹发散提供了一种只有ATCPG-SO(仅状态变量)才能使用的独立时序信号。这种扩展将平均双曲扩散（kappa）从1.88提高到3.37，并且与单独状态基线相比，效率进一步提高了5.8%。跨五个随机种子的消融实验表明：（i）学习是主要的效率因素（比无学习高54.8%），（ii）双曲扩散提供了显著的互补增益（比无几何控制高26.2%），（iii）组合系统比固定间隔基线提高了22.8%的效率，以及（iv）将空间位置信息添加到扩散嵌入中产生了额外的5.8%的增益。

title: A Context Engineering Framework for Improving Enterprise AI Agents based on Digital-Twin MDP
summary: Despite rapid progress in AI agents for enterprise automation and decision-making, their real-world deployment and further performance gains remain constrained by limited data quality and quantity, complex real-world reasoning demands, difficulties with self-play, and the lack of reliable feedback signals. To address these challenges, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic framework for improving LLM-based enterprise agents via offline reinforcement learning (RL). The proposed Context Engineering via DT-MDP (DT-MDP-CE) framework comprises three key components: (1) A Digital-Twin Markov Decision Process (DT-MDP), which abstracts the agent's reasoning behavior as a finite MDP; (2) A robust contrastive inverse RL, which, armed with the DT-MDP, to efficiently estimate a well-founded reward function and induces policies from mixed-quality offline trajectories; and (3) RL-guided context engineering, which uses the policy obtained from the integrated process of (1) and (2), to improve the agent's decision-making behavior. As a case study, we apply the framework to a representative task in the enterprise-oriented domain of IT automation. Extensive experimental results demonstrate consistent and significant improvements over baseline agents across a wide range of evaluation settings, suggesting that the framework can generalize to other agents sharing similar characteristics in enterprise environments.
tldr: This paper introduces a framework (DT-MDP-CE) for improving enterprise AI agents using offline RL and digital twins to address data limitations and enhance decision-making, demonstrating significant improvements in IT automation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为DT-MDP-CE的框架，该框架利用离线强化学习和数字孪生来改进企业AI代理，以解决数据限制并增强决策能力，并在IT自动化任务中展示了显著的改进。
summary_zh: 尽管人工智能代理在企业自动化和决策制定方面取得了快速进展，但其在现实世界的部署以及进一步的性能提升仍然受到数据质量和数量有限、复杂的现实世界推理需求、自我对弈的困难以及缺乏可靠反馈信号的限制。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种轻量级的、与模型无关的框架，通过离线强化学习（RL）改进基于大型语言模型的企业代理。所提出的基于DT-MDP的上下文工程（DT-MDP-CE）框架包含三个关键组成部分：（1）数字孪生马尔可夫决策过程（DT-MDP），它将代理的推理行为抽象为一个有限MDP；（2）一种鲁棒的对比逆强化学习方法，该方法在DT-MDP的支持下，能够有效地估计一个完善的奖励函数，并从混合质量的离线轨迹中推导出策略；（3）强化学习指导的上下文工程，它利用从（1）和（2）的集成过程中获得的策略，来改进代理的决策行为。作为一个案例研究，我们将该框架应用于IT自动化这一面向企业的领域中的一个代表性任务。大量的实验结果表明，在各种评估环境中，相对于基准代理，该框架能够实现持续且显著的改进，这表明该框架可以推广到企业环境中具有类似特征的其他代理。

title: Future-Interactions-Aware Trajectory Prediction via Braid Theory
summary: To safely operate, an autonomous vehicle must know the future behavior of a potentially high number of interacting agents around it, a task often posed as multi-agent trajectory prediction. Many previous attempts to model social interactions and solve the joint prediction task either add extensive computational requirements or rely on heuristics to label multi-agent behavior types. Braid theory, in contrast, provides a powerful exact descriptor of multi-agent behavior by projecting future trajectories into braids that express how trajectories cross with each other over time; a braid then corresponds to a specific mode of coordination between the multiple agents in the future. In past work, braids have been used lightly to reason about interacting agents and restrict the attention window of predicted agents. We show that leveraging more fully the expressivity of the braid representation and using it to condition the trajectories themselves leads to even further gains in joint prediction performance, with negligible added complexity either in training or at inference time. We do so by proposing a novel auxiliary task, braid prediction, done in parallel with the trajectory prediction task. By classifying edges between agents into their correct crossing types in the braid representation, the braid prediction task is able to imbue the model with improved social awareness, which is reflected in joint predictions that more closely adhere to the actual multi-agent behavior. This simple auxiliary task allowed us to obtain significant improvements in joint metrics on three separate datasets. We show how the braid prediction task infuses the model with future intention awareness, leading to more accurate joint predictions. Code is available at github.com/caiocj1/traj-pred-braid-theory.
tldr: The paper introduces a novel approach for multi-agent trajectory prediction using braid theory to model social interactions, leading to improved joint prediction performance with negligible added complexity through a braid prediction auxiliary task.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种利用辫子理论建模社交互动来进行多智能体轨迹预测的新方法，通过辫子预测辅助任务，以可忽略的复杂度提升联合预测性能。
summary_zh: 为了安全运行，自动驾驶汽车必须了解周围潜在大量交互主体的未来行为，这项任务通常被定义为多智能体轨迹预测。 许多先前对社会互动建模并解决联合预测任务的尝试，要么增加了大量的计算需求，要么依赖于启发式方法来标记多智能体行为类型。 相比之下，辫子理论通过将未来的轨迹投影到辫子中，从而提供了一种强大的、精确的多智能体行为描述符，这些辫子表达了轨迹随时间推移如何相互交叉；然后，辫子对应于多个智能体之间未来的特定协调模式。 在过去的工作中，辫子已被少量用于推理交互智能体并限制预测智能体的注意力窗口。 我们证明了更充分地利用辫子表示的表达能力，并利用它来调节轨迹本身，可以在联合预测性能上获得更大的提升，而无论是在训练还是推理时，增加的复杂性都可忽略不计。 我们通过提出一种新颖的辅助任务，即辫子预测，与轨迹预测任务并行完成。 通过在辫子表示中将智能体之间的边分类为正确的交叉类型，辫子预测任务能够使模型具有更高的社会意识，这反映在更符合实际多智能体行为的联合预测中。 这个简单的辅助任务使我们在三个独立的数据集上获得了联合指标的显著改进。 我们展示了辫子预测任务如何为模型注入未来意图意识，从而产生更准确的联合预测。 代码可在 github.com/caiocj1/traj-pred-braid-theory 获取。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning and The Tale of Two Temporal Difference Errors
summary: The temporal difference (TD) error was first formalized in Sutton (1988), where it was first characterized as the difference between temporally successive predictions, and later, in that same work, formulated as the difference between a bootstrapped target and a prediction. Since then, these two interpretations of the TD error have been used interchangeably in the literature, with the latter eventually being adopted as the standard critic loss in deep reinforcement learning (RL) architectures. In this work, we show that these two interpretations of the TD error are not always equivalent. In particular, we show that increasingly-nonlinear deep RL architectures can cause these interpretations of the TD error to yield increasingly different numerical values. Then, building on this insight, we show how choosing one interpretation of the TD error over the other can affect the performance of deep RL algorithms that utilize the TD error to compute other quantities, such as with deep differential (i.e., average-reward) RL methods. All in all, our results show that the default interpretation of the TD error as the difference between a bootstrapped target and a prediction does not always hold in deep RL settings.
tldr: This paper demonstrates that two common interpretations of the Temporal Difference (TD) error in deep reinforcement learning can diverge with highly nonlinear architectures, impacting the performance of algorithms that depend on TD error calculations.
tldr_zh: 本文证明了在深度强化学习中，时间差（TD）误差的两种常见解释在高非线性架构中可能会有所不同，从而影响依赖于TD误差计算的算法的性能。
summary_zh: 时间差分(TD)误差最初由Sutton (1988) 正式提出，最早其被描述为时间上连续预测之间的差异，之后在该工作中，被定义为自举目标和预测之间的差异。自此，对TD误差的这两种解释在文献中一直互换使用，后者最终被采纳为深度强化学习(RL)架构中的标准评价者损失。在这项工作中，我们表明TD误差的这两种解释并非总是等价的。特别是，我们展示了日益非线性的深度强化学习架构会导致对TD误差的这两种解释产生越来越不同的数值。进而，基于这一洞见，我们展示了在深度差分（即，平均奖励）强化学习方法等利用TD误差计算其他量的深度强化学习算法中，选择TD误差的哪一种解释会如何影响算法的性能。总而言之，我们的结果表明，在深度强化学习环境中，将TD误差默认为自举目标和预测之间的差异这一解释并不总是成立。

title: Reasoning Provenance for Autonomous AI Agents: Structured Behavioral Analytics Beyond State Checkpoints and Execution Traces
summary: As AI agents transition from human-supervised copilots to autonomous platform infrastructure, the ability to analyze their reasoning behavior across populations of investigations becomes a pressing infrastructure requirement. Existing operational tooling addresses adjacent needs effectively: state checkpoint systems enable fault tolerance; observability platforms provide execution traces for debugging; telemetry standards ensure interoperability. What current systems do not natively provide as a first-class, schema-level primitive is structured reasoning provenance -- normalized, queryable records of why the agent chose each action, what it concluded from each observation, how each conclusion shaped its strategy, and which evidence supports its final verdict. This paper introduces the Agent Execution Record (AER), a structured reasoning provenance primitive that captures intent, observation, and inference as first-class queryable fields on every step, alongside versioned plans with revision rationale, evidence chains, structured verdicts with confidence scores, and delegation authority chains. We formalize the distinction between computational state persistence and reasoning provenance, argue that the latter cannot in general be faithfully reconstructed from the former, and show how AERs enable population-level behavioral analytics: reasoning pattern mining, confidence calibration, cross-agent comparison, and counterfactual regression testing via mock replay. We present a domain-agnostic model with extensible domain profiles, a reference implementation and SDK, and outline an evaluation methodology informed by preliminary deployment on a production platformized root cause analysis agent.
tldr: This paper introduces the Agent Execution Record (AER), a structured reasoning provenance primitive for autonomous AI agents, enabling population-level behavioral analytics that are not easily achievable using existing methods like state checkpoints or execution traces.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为“Agent Execution Record (AER)”的结构化推理溯源原语，用于自主AI智能体。该原语能够实现群体层面的行为分析，而使用现有的状态检查点或执行跟踪等方法很难实现。
summary_zh: 随着人工智能代理从人类监督的副驾驶过渡到自主平台基础设施，分析它们在大量调查中的推理行为的能力成为一项紧迫的基础设施需求。现有的运营工具有效地解决了相邻需求：状态检查点系统实现了容错；可观测性平台提供了用于调试的执行追踪；遥测标准确保了互操作性。当前系统没有原生提供作为一级模式级别基本要素的是结构化推理溯源 —— 对代理选择每个动作的原因、从每个观察中得出什么结论、每个结论如何塑造其策略以及哪些证据支持其最终结论进行规范化、可查询的记录。本文介绍了 Agent Execution Record (AER)，一种结构化推理溯源基本要素，它在每个步骤中将意图、观察和推理捕获为可查询的一级字段，同时还包括带有修订理由的版本化计划、证据链、带有置信度分数的结构化判决以及委托权限链。我们形式化了计算状态持久性和推理溯源之间的区别，认为后者通常无法从前者忠实地重建，并展示了 AER 如何实现群体层面的行为分析：推理模式挖掘、置信度校准、跨代理比较以及通过模拟重放进行反事实回归测试。我们提出了一个具有可扩展域配置文件的与域无关模型、一个参考实现和 SDK，并概述了一个由在生产平台化根因分析代理上的初步部署所指导的评估方法。

title: Spatio-Temporal Attention Enhanced Multi-Agent DRL for UAV-Assisted Wireless Networks with Limited Communications
summary: In this paper, we employ multiple UAVs to accelerate data transmissions from ground users (GUs) to a remote base station (BS) via the UAVs' relay communications. The UAVs' intermittent information exchanges typically result in delays in acquiring the complete system state and hinder their effective collaboration. To maximize the overall throughput, we first propose a delay-tolerant multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) algorithm that integrates a delay-penalized reward to encourage information sharing among UAVs, while jointly optimizing the UAVs' trajectory planning, network formation, and transmission control strategies. Additionally, considering information loss due to unreliable channel conditions, we further propose a spatio-temporal attention based prediction approach to recover the lost information and enhance each UAV's awareness of the network state. These two designs are envisioned to enhance the network capacity in UAV-assisted wireless networks with limited communications. The simulation results reveal that our new approach achieves over 50\% reduction in information delay and 75% throughput gain compared to the conventional MADRL. Interestingly, it is shown that improving the UAVs' information sharing will not sacrifice the network capacity. Instead, it significantly improves the learning performance and throughput simultaneously. It is also effective in reducing the need for UAVs' information exchange and thus fostering practical deployment of MADRL in UAV-assisted wireless networks.
tldr: The paper proposes a delay-tolerant MADRL algorithm with spatio-temporal attention to enhance information sharing and throughput in UAV-assisted wireless networks with limited communications, achieving significant improvements over conventional MADRL.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种具有时空注意力的容错MADRL算法，旨在增强通信受限的无人机辅助无线网络中的信息共享和吞吐量，与传统MADRL相比，取得了显著的改进。
summary_zh: 本文采用多架无人机，通过无人机的中继通信来加速地面用户(GU)向远程基站(BS)的数据传输。无人机间断性的信息交换通常会导致获取完整系统状态的延迟，并阻碍其有效协作。为了最大化整体吞吐量，我们首先提出了一种容忍延迟的多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）算法，该算法集成了延迟惩罚奖励，以鼓励无人机之间的信息共享，同时联合优化无人机的轨迹规划、网络形成和传输控制策略。此外，考虑到不可靠信道条件导致的信息丢失，我们进一步提出一种基于时空注意力机制的预测方法，以恢复丢失的信息并增强每个无人机对网络状态的感知。这两种设计旨在增强通信受限的无人机辅助无线网络中的网络容量。仿真结果表明，与传统的MADRL相比，我们的新方法在信息延迟方面实现了超过50％的降低，吞吐量增益达75％。有趣的是，结果表明，改善无人机的信息共享不会牺牲网络容量。相反，它显著提高了学习性能和吞吐量。它还能有效减少无人机信息交换的需求，从而促进MADRL在无人机辅助无线网络中的实际部署。

title: Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Collaborative multi-agent large language models (LLMs) can solve complex reasoning tasks by decomposing roles and aggregating diverse hypotheses. Yet, reinforcement learning (RL) for such systems is often undermined by credit assignment: a shared global reward obscures individual contributions, inflating update variance and encouraging free-riding. We introduce Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization (CCPO), a framework that assigns agent-specific learning signals by estimating each agent's marginal contribution through counterfactual trajectories. CCPO builds dynamic counterfactual baselines that simulate outcomes with an agent's contribution removed, yielding role-sensitive advantages for policy optimization. To further improve stability under heterogeneous tasks and data distributions, we propose a global-history-aware normalization scheme that calibrates advantages using global rollout statistics. We evaluate CCPO on two collaboration topologies: a sequential Think--Reason dyad and multi-agent voting. Across mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks, CCPO mitigates free-riding and outperforms strong multi-agent RL baselines, yielding finer-grained and more effective credit assignment for collaborative LLM training. Our code is available at https://github.com/bhai114/ccpo.
tldr: The paper introduces Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization (CCPO), a reinforcement learning framework for collaborative multi-agent LLMs that addresses the credit assignment problem by using counterfactual trajectories to estimate each agent's marginal contribution. CCPO outperforms other multi-agent RL approaches on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了反事实信用策略优化（CCPO），这是一种用于协作式多智能体LLM的强化学习框架，它通过使用反事实轨迹来估计每个智能体的边际贡献，从而解决信用分配问题。CCPO在数学和逻辑推理任务上优于其他多智能体RL方法。
summary_zh: 协同多智能体大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过分解角色和聚合多样化假设来解决复杂的推理任务。然而，此类系统的强化学习（RL）常常被信用分配问题所削弱：共享的全局奖励掩盖了单个智能体的贡献，放大了更新方差并鼓励搭便车行为。我们提出了反事实信用策略优化（CCPO），该框架通过估计每个智能体通过反事实轨迹所做的边际贡献，来分配智能体特定的学习信号。CCPO 构建动态反事实基线，模拟移除智能体贡献后的结果，从而为策略优化产生角色敏感的优势。为了进一步提高在异构任务和数据分布下的稳定性，我们提出了一种全局历史感知归一化方案，该方案使用全局 rollout 统计数据来校准优势。我们在两种协作拓扑结构上评估了 CCPO：一个序列化的思考——推理二元组和一个多智能体投票。在数学和逻辑推理基准测试中，CCPO 减轻了搭便车行为，并优于强大的多智能体 RL 基线，为协同 LLM 训练产生更细粒度和更有效的信用分配。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/bhai114/ccpo 获取。

title: Efficient Failure Management for Multi-Agent Systems with Reasoning Trace Representation
summary: Large Language Models (LLM)-based Multi-Agent Systems (MASs) have emerged as a new paradigm in software system design, increasingly demonstrating strong reasoning and collaboration capabilities. As these systems become more complex and autonomous, effective failure management is essential to ensure reliability and availability. However, existing approaches often rely on per-trace reasoning, which leads to low efficiency, and neglect historical failure patterns, limiting diagnostic accuracy. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary empirical study to demonstrate the necessity, potential, and challenges of leveraging historical failure patterns to enhance failure management in MASs. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{EAGER}, an efficient failure management framework for multi-agent systems based on reasoning trace representation. EAGER employs unsupervised reasoning-scoped contrastive learning to encode both intra-agent reasoning and inter-agent coordination, enabling real-time step-wise failure detection, diagnosis, and reflexive mitigation guided by historical failure knowledge. Preliminary evaluations on three open-source MASs demonstrate the effectiveness of EAGER and highlight promising directions for future research in reliable multi-agent system operations.
tldr: The paper introduces EAGER, a framework for efficient failure management in LLM-based multi-agent systems, leveraging reasoning trace representation and contrastive learning to enable real-time failure detection, diagnosis, and mitigation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EAGER，一个用于LLM多智能体系统中的高效故障管理框架。该框架利用推理轨迹表示和对比学习，实现了实时的故障检测、诊断和缓解。
summary_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MASs）已经成为软件系统设计中的一种新范式，日益展现出强大的推理和协作能力。随着这些系统变得越来越复杂和自主，有效的故障管理对于确保可靠性和可用性至关重要。然而，现有方法通常依赖于基于单次迹线的推理，导致效率低下，并且忽略了历史故障模式，从而限制了诊断的准确性。在本文中，我们进行了一项初步的实证研究，以证明利用历史故障模式来增强MASs中的故障管理的必要性、潜力和挑战。基于这一洞察，我们提出了\textbf{EAGER}，一种基于推理迹线表示的多智能体系统高效故障管理框架。EAGER采用无监督的推理范围对比学习来编码智能体内部推理和智能体间协调，从而能够基于历史故障知识引导实时的步进式故障检测、诊断和自反式缓解。在三个开源MASs上的初步评估表明了EAGER的有效性，并突出了未来在可靠多智能体系统操作方面的有前景的研究方向。

title: EgoGroups: A Benchmark For Detecting Social Groups of People in the Wild
summary: Social group detection, or the identification of humans involved in reciprocal interpersonal interactions (e.g., family members, friends, and customers and merchants), is a crucial component of social intelligence needed for agents transacting in the world. The few existing benchmarks for social group detection are limited by low scene diversity and reliance on third-person camera sources (e.g., surveillance footage). Consequently, these benchmarks generally lack real-world evaluation on how groups form and evolve in diverse cultural contexts and unconstrained settings. To address this gap, we introduce EgoGroups, a first-person view dataset that captures social dynamics in cities around the world. EgoGroups spans 65 countries covering low, medium, and high-crowd settings under four weather/time-of-day conditions. We include dense human annotations for person and social groups, along with rich geographic and scene metadata. Using this dataset, we performed an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLM/LLMs and supervised models on their group detection capabilities. We found several interesting findings, including VLMs and LLMs can outperform supervised baselines in a zero-shot setting, while crowd density and cultural regions clearly influence model performance.
tldr: The paper introduces EgoGroups, a novel first-person view dataset for social group detection in diverse real-world settings, and evaluates VLM/LLM and supervised models on this dataset, finding interesting insights about their performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了EgoGroups，一个新颖的第一人称视角数据集，用于在不同的真实世界环境中进行社交群体检测，并在该数据集上评估VLM/LLM和监督模型，发现了关于其性能的有趣见解。
summary_zh: 社交群体检测，或识别参与互惠人际互动的人员（例如，家庭成员、朋友以及顾客和商家），是智能体在世界中进行交互所需的社会智能的关键组成部分。现有的少量社交群体检测基准测试受限于场景多样性低和对第三人称摄像头来源（例如，监控录像）的依赖。因此，这些基准测试通常缺乏对群体如何在不同文化背景和无约束设置中形成和演变的真实世界评估。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了EgoGroups，这是一个第一人称视角数据集，捕捉了世界各城市中的社交动态。EgoGroups涵盖了65个国家，包括低、中、高拥挤度场景，并覆盖了四种天气/时间条件。我们包含了密集的人工标注，包括人员和社交群体，以及丰富的地理和场景元数据。利用该数据集，我们对最先进的VLM/LLM和监督模型进行了广泛的评估，以考察它们在群体检测方面的能力。我们发现了一些有趣的结论，包括VLMs和LLMs可以在零样本设置中优于监督基线，而人群密度和文化区域明显影响了模型的性能。

title: PAM: A Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for Sim-to-Real HOI Video Generation
summary: Hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction and synthesis are becoming central to embodied AI and AR/VR. Yet, despite rapid progress, existing HOI generation research remains fragmented across three disjoint tracks: (1) pose-only synthesis that predicts MANO trajectories without producing pixels; (2) single-image HOI generation that hallucinates appearance from masks or 2D cues but lacks dynamics; and (3) video generation methods that require both the entire pose sequence and the ground-truth first frame as inputs, preventing true sim-to-real deployment. Inspired by the philosophy of Joo et al. (2018), we think that HOI generation requires a unified engine that brings together pose, appearance, and motion within one coherent framework. Thus we introduce PAM: a Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for controllable HOI video generation. The performance of our engine is validated by: (1) On DexYCB, we obtain an FVD of 29.13 (vs. 38.83 for InterDyn), and MPJPE of 19.37 mm (vs. 30.05 mm for CosHand), while generating higher-resolution 480x720 videos compared to 256x256 and 256x384 baselines. (2) On OAKINK2, our full multi-condition model improves FVD from 68.76 to 46.31. (3) An ablation over input conditions on DexYCB shows that combining depth, segmentation, and keypoints consistently yields the best results. (4) For a downstream hand pose estimation task using SimpleHand, augmenting training with 3,400 synthetic videos (207k frames) allows a model trained on only 50% of the real data plus our synthetic data to match the 100% real baseline.
tldr: The paper introduces PAM, a Pose-Appearance-Motion Engine for controllable hand-object interaction (HOI) video generation, addressing limitations in existing methods by unifying pose, appearance, and motion.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了PAM，一个姿态-外观-运动引擎，用于可控的手-物体交互(HOI)视频生成，通过统一姿态、外观和运动，解决了现有方法的局限性。
summary_zh: 手部-物体交互 (HOI) 重建与合成正日益成为具身人工智能和增强/虚拟现实的核心。然而，尽管取得了快速进展，现有的 HOI 生成研究仍然分散在三个不相关的方向：（1）仅姿态合成，预测 MANO 轨迹而不生成像素；（2）单图像 HOI 生成，从掩码或 2D 线索推断外观，但缺乏动态；和（3）视频生成方法，需要完整的姿态序列和真实的第一帧作为输入，从而阻碍了真正的仿真-真实部署。受到 Joo 等人 (2018) 哲学的启发，我们认为 HOI 生成需要一个统一的引擎，将姿态、外观和运动整合到一个连贯的框架中。因此，我们引入了 PAM：一个用于可控 HOI 视频生成的姿态-外观-运动引擎。我们引擎的性能通过以下方式验证：（1）在 DexYCB 上，我们获得了 29.13 的 FVD（InterDyn 为 38.83），以及 19.37 毫米的 MPJPE（CosHand 为 30.05 毫米），同时生成了更高分辨率的 480x720 视频，而基线为 256x256 和 256x384。（2）在 OAKINK2 上，我们的完整多条件模型将 FVD 从 68.76 提升至 46.31。（3）在 DexYCB 上对输入条件进行的消融实验表明，结合深度、分割和关键点始终能产生最佳结果。（4）对于使用 SimpleHand 的下游手部姿态估计任务，使用 3,400 个合成视频（207k 帧）增强训练，使得仅在 50% 的真实数据加上我们的合成数据上训练的模型能够与 100% 真实数据的基线相匹配。

title: OpenEarth-Agent: From Tool Calling to Tool Creation for Open-Environment Earth Observation
summary: Earth Observation (EO) is essential for perceiving dynamic land surface changes, yet deploying autonomous EO in open environments is hindered by the immense diversity of multi-source data and heterogeneous tasks. While remote sensing agents have emerged to streamline EO workflows, existing tool-calling agents are confined to closed environments. They rely on pre-defined tools and are restricted to narrow scope, limiting their generalization to the diverse data and tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OpenEarth-Agent, the first tool-creation agent framework tailored for open-environment EO. Rather than calling predefined tools, OpenEarth-Agent employs adaptive workflow planning and tool creation to generalize to unseen data and tasks. This adaptability is bolstered by an open-ended integration of multi-stage tools and cross-domain knowledge bases, enabling robust execution in the entire EO pipeline across multiple application domains. To comprehensively evaluate EO agents in open environments, we propose OpenEarth-Bench, a novel benchmark comprising 596 real-world, full-pipeline cases across seven application domains, explicitly designed to assess agents' adaptive planning and tool creation capabilities. Only essential pre-trained model tools are provided in this benchmark, devoid of any other predefined task-specific tools. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OpenEarth-Agent successfully masters full-pipeline EO across multiple domains in the open environment. Notably, on the cross-benchmark Earth-Bench, our tool-creating agent equipped with 6 essential pre-trained models achieves performance comparable to tool-calling agents relying on 104 specialized tools, and significantly outperforms them when provided with the complete toolset. In several cases, the created tools exhibit superior robustness to data anomalies compared to human-engineered counterparts.
tldr: The paper introduces OpenEarth-Agent, a tool-creation agent framework for Earth Observation in open environments, which adaptively plans and creates tools to address the limitations of existing tool-calling agents. It also proposes OpenEarth-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating EO agents.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了OpenEarth-Agent，一个用于开放环境地球观测的工具创建代理框架，它自适应地规划和创建工具，以解决现有工具调用代理的局限性。此外，论文还提出了OpenEarth-Bench，一个新的用于评估EO代理的基准。
summary_zh: 地球观测（EO）对于感知动态地表变化至关重要，然而，在开放环境中部署自主EO受到多源数据和异构任务巨大多样性的制约。虽然遥感智能代理已出现以简化EO工作流程，但现有的调用工具智能代理仅限于封闭环境。它们依赖于预定义的工具，且范围狭窄，限制了其对多样化数据和任务的泛化能力。为了克服这些局限性，我们引入了 OpenEarth-Agent，这是第一个专为开放环境 EO 量身定制的工具创建智能代理框架。OpenEarth-Agent 不调用预定义的工具，而是采用自适应工作流规划和工具创建来泛化到未见过的数据和任务。这种适应性得益于多阶段工具和跨领域知识库的开放式集成，从而能够在跨多个应用领域的整个 EO 流程中实现稳健的执行。为了全面评估开放环境中的 EO 智能代理，我们提出了 OpenEarth-Bench，这是一个新颖的基准测试，包含 596 个真实世界的、完整的流程案例，涵盖七个应用领域，专门用于评估智能代理的自适应规划和工具创建能力。该基准测试中仅提供必要的预训练模型工具，没有任何其他预定义的特定于任务的工具。广泛的实验表明，OpenEarth-Agent 成功地掌握了开放环境中跨多个领域的完整流程 EO。值得注意的是，在跨基准测试 Earth-Bench 上，我们配备 6 个基本预训练模型的工具创建智能代理实现了与依赖 104 个专用工具的工具调用智能代理相当的性能，并且在使用完整工具集时显着优于它们。在某些情况下，创建的工具比人工设计的工具表现出更优的数据异常鲁棒性。

title: Adapting Point Cloud Analysis via Multimodal Bayesian Distribution Learning
summary: Multimodal 3D vision-language models show strong generalization across diverse 3D tasks, but their performance still degrades notably under domain shifts. This has motivated recent studies on test-time adaptation (TTA), which enables models to adapt online using test-time data. Among existing TTA methods, cache-based mechanisms are widely adopted for leveraging previously observed samples in online prediction refinement. However, they store only limited historical information, leading to progressive information loss as the test stream evolves. In addition, their prediction logits are fused heuristically, making adaptation unstable. To address these limitations, we propose BayesMM, a Multimodal Bayesian Distribution Learning framework for test-time point cloud analysis. BayesMM models textual priors and streaming visual features of each class as Gaussian distributions: textual parameters are derived from semantic prompts, while visual parameters are updated online with arriving samples. The two modalities are fused via Bayesian model averaging, which automatically adjusts their contributions based on posterior evidence, yielding a unified prediction that adapts continually to evolving test-time data without training. Extensive experiments on multiple point cloud benchmarks demonstrate that BayesMM maintains robustness under distributional shifts, yielding over 4% average improvement.
tldr: The paper introduces BayesMM, a novel test-time adaptation framework for point cloud analysis that uses Bayesian model averaging to fuse textual priors and streaming visual features, improving robustness under distributional shifts.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 BayesMM，一种新颖的点云分析测试时自适应框架，它使用贝叶斯模型平均融合文本先验和流式视觉特征，从而提高在分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 多模态3D视觉-语言模型在各种3D任务中展现出强大的泛化能力，但其性能在领域偏移下仍然显著下降。这促使人们对测试时自适应（TTA）展开研究，该技术使模型能够利用测试数据进行在线自适应。在现有的TTA方法中，基于缓存的机制被广泛应用于在线预测优化，以利用先前观察到的样本。然而，它们仅存储有限的历史信息，导致随着测试流的演进，信息逐渐丢失。此外，它们的预测logits以启发式方式融合，使得自适应不稳定。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了BayesMM，一个用于测试时点云分析的多模态贝叶斯分布学习框架。BayesMM将每个类别的文本先验和流式视觉特征建模为高斯分布：文本参数来源于语义提示，而视觉参数则随着新样本的到来进行在线更新。两种模态通过贝叶斯模型平均进行融合，后者根据后验证据自动调整它们的贡献，从而产生一个统一的预测，该预测持续适应不断演进的测试时数据，而无需训练。在多个点云基准测试上的大量实验表明，BayesMM在分布偏移下保持了鲁棒性，产生了超过4%的平均提升。

title: GeoFlow: Real-Time Fine-Grained Cross-View Geolocalization via Iterative Flow Prediction
summary: Accurate and fast localization is vital for safe autonomous navigation in GPS-denied areas. Fine-Grained Cross-View Geolocalization (FG-CVG) aims to estimate the precise 2-Degree-of-Freedom (2-DoF) location of a ground image relative to a satellite image. However, current methods force a difficult trade-off, with high-accuracy models being slow for real-time use. In this paper, we introduce GeoFlow, a new approach that offers a lightweight and highly efficient framework that breaks this accuracy-speed trade-off. Our technique learns a direct probabilistic mapping, predicting the displacement (in distance and direction) required to correct any given location hypothesis. This is complemented by our novel inference algorithm, Iterative Refinement Sampling (IRS). Instead of trusting a single prediction, IRS refines a population of hypotheses, allowing them to iteratively 'flow' from random starting points to a robust, converged consensus. Even its iterative nature, this approach offers flexible inference-time scaling, allowing a direct trade-off between performance and computation without any re-training. Experiments on the KITTI and VIGOR datasets show that GeoFlow achieves state-of-the-art efficiency, running at real-time speeds of 29 FPS while maintaining competitive localization accuracy. This work opens a new path for the development of practical real-time geolocalization systems.
tldr: The paper introduces GeoFlow, a real-time and accurate method for fine-grained cross-view geolocalization using iterative flow prediction for autonomous navigation in GPS-denied areas. It achieves state-of-the-art efficiency and accuracy on KITTI and VIGOR datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 GeoFlow，一种实时且准确的细粒度跨视角地理定位方法，使用迭代流预测技术，适用于GPS受限环境下的自主导航。在KITTI和VIGOR数据集上实现了最先进的效率和准确性指标。
summary_zh: 在GPS受限区域，准确而快速的定位对于安全自主导航至关重要。细粒度跨视角地理定位（FG-CVG）旨在估计地面图像相对于卫星图像的精确二自由度（2-DoF）位置。然而，目前的方法迫使人们在高精度模型速度慢和适合实时应用之间做出艰难的权衡。本文提出GeoFlow，一种新的方法，提供了一个轻量级且高效的框架，打破了这种精度-速度的折衷。我们的技术学习一种直接的概率映射，预测纠正任何给定位置假设所需的位移（距离和方向）。 此外，我们还提出了新的推理算法，即迭代细化采样（IRS）。 IRS不是信任单个预测，而是细化一个假设群体，使它们能够从随机起点迭代地“流动”到稳健的、收敛的共识。即使是其迭代特性，该方法也提供了灵活的推理时间调整，允许在性能和计算之间进行直接权衡，而无需任何再训练。在KITTI和VIGOR数据集上的实验表明，GeoFlow实现了最先进的效率，以29 FPS的实时速度运行，同时保持了具有竞争力的定位精度。这项工作为开发实用的实时地理定位系统开辟了一条新途径。

title: Getting to the Point: Why Pointing Improves LVLMs
summary: Pointing increases the accuracy and explainability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by modeling grounding and reasoning as explicit sequential steps. The model grounds the objects mentioned in the natural-language query by predicting their coordinates, and then generates an answer conditioned on these points. While pointing has been shown to increase LVLMs' accuracy, it is unclear which mechanism supports these gains and its relevance in cognitive tasks. In addition, the reliability of the intermediate points remains understudied, limiting their use as visual explanations. In this work, we study the role of pointing in a cognitive task: zero-shot counting from a visual scene. We fine-tune state-of-the-art LVLMs following two approaches: Direct Counting, where models only predict the total number of objects, and Point-then-Count, where LVLMs generate the target objects' coordinates followed by their count. The results show that Point-then-Count achieves higher out-of-distribution generalization, suggesting that coordinates help LVLMs learn skills rather than overfitting on narrow tasks. Although predicted points are accurately grounded in the image in over 89\% of cases (as measured by F1), performance varies across image regions, revealing spatial biases. Finally, mechanistic analyses show that gains in counting arise from the spatial information encoded in the coordinates.
tldr: This paper investigates how pointing enhances Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by enabling explicit grounding and reasoning, showing improved out-of-distribution generalization in zero-shot counting tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了指向如何通过实现显式接地和推理来增强大型视觉语言模型 (LVLM)，从而在零样本计数任务中表现出更好的分布外泛化能力。
summary_zh: 指向通过将 grounding 和推理建模为显式的顺序步骤，从而提高大型视觉-语言模型 (LVLMs) 的准确性和可解释性。该模型通过预测自然语言查询中提到的对象的坐标来 grounding 这些对象，然后生成以这些点为条件的答案。虽然指向已被证明可以提高 LVLMs 的准确性，但尚不清楚哪种机制支持这些提升，以及它在认知任务中的相关性。此外，中间点的可靠性仍未得到充分研究，限制了它们作为视觉解释的使用。在本工作中，我们研究指向在认知任务中的作用：视觉场景中的零样本计数。我们采用两种方法微调最先进的 LVLMs：直接计数，其中模型仅预测对象的总数；以及先指向后计数，其中 LVLMs 生成目标对象的坐标，然后生成其计数。结果表明，先指向后计数实现了更高的超出分布的泛化能力，这表明坐标有助于 LVLMs 学习技能，而不是过度拟合狭窄的任务。尽管预测的点在超过 89% 的情况下准确地 grounding 在图像中（如 F1 所衡量），但性能在图像区域之间存在差异，揭示了空间偏差。最后，机制分析表明，计数方面的提升源于坐标中编码的空间信息。

title: Back to Point: Exploring Point-Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Anomaly Detection
summary: Zero-shot (ZS) 3D anomaly detection is crucial for reliable industrial inspection, as it enables detecting and localizing defects without requiring any target-category training data. Existing approaches render 3D point clouds into 2D images and leverage pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for anomaly detection. However, such strategies inevitably discard geometric details and exhibit limited sensitivity to local anomalies. In this paper, we revisit intrinsic 3D representations and explore the potential of pre-trained Point-Language Models (PLMs) for ZS 3D anomaly detection. We propose BTP (Back To Point), a novel framework that effectively aligns 3D point cloud and textual embeddings. Specifically, BTP aligns multi-granularity patch features with textual representations for localized anomaly detection, while incorporating geometric descriptors to enhance sensitivity to structural anomalies. Furthermore, we introduce a joint representation learning strategy that leverages auxiliary point cloud data to improve robustness and enrich anomaly semantics. Extensive experiments on Real3D-AD and Anomaly-ShapeNet demonstrate that BTP achieves superior performance in ZS 3D anomaly detection. Code will be available at \href{https://github.com/wistful-8029/BTP-3DAD}{https://github.com/wistful-8029/BTP-3DAD}.
tldr: This paper introduces BTP, a novel framework leveraging pre-trained Point-Language Models (PLMs) for zero-shot 3D anomaly detection, effectively aligning 3D point clouds and textual embeddings and achieving superior performance on benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为BTP的新框架，该框架利用预训练的点-语言模型（PLM）进行零样本3D异常检测，有效地对齐3D点云和文本嵌入，并在基准数据集上实现了卓越的性能。
summary_zh: 零样本(ZS) 3D异常检测对于可靠的工业检测至关重要，因为它能够在无需任何目标类别训练数据的情况下检测和定位缺陷。现有方法将3D点云渲染成2D图像，并利用预训练的视觉-语言模型(VLMs)进行异常检测。然而，这些策略不可避免地会丢弃几何细节，并且对局部异常的敏感性有限。在本文中，我们重新审视了内在3D表示，并探索了预训练的点云-语言模型(PLMs)在ZS 3D异常检测中的潜力。 我们提出了一种名为BTP（Back To Point，回到点）的新颖框架，该框架有效地对齐了3D点云和文本嵌入。 具体来说，BTP将多粒度patch特征与文本表示对齐，以进行局部异常检测，同时结合了几何描述符以增强对结构异常的敏感性。 此外，我们引入了一种联合表示学习策略，该策略利用辅助点云数据来提高鲁棒性并丰富异常语义。 在Real3D-AD和Anomaly-ShapeNet上的大量实验表明，BTP在ZS 3D异常检测中取得了卓越的性能。 代码将在\href{https://github.com/wistful-8029/BTP-3DAD}{https://github.com/wistful-8029/BTP-3DAD}提供。

title: CellFluxRL: Biologically-Constrained Virtual Cell Modeling via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Building virtual cells with generative models to simulate cellular behavior in silico is emerging as a promising paradigm for accelerating drug discovery. However, prior image-based generative approaches can produce implausible cell images that violate basic physical and biological constraints. To address this, we propose to post-train virtual cell models with reinforcement learning (RL), leveraging biologically meaningful evaluators as reward functions. We design seven rewards spanning three categories-biological function, structural validity, and morphological correctness-and optimize the state-of-the-art CellFlux model to yield CellFluxRL. CellFluxRL consistently improves over CellFlux across all rewards, with further performance boosts from test-time scaling. Overall, our results present a virtual cell modeling framework that enforces physically-based constraints through RL, advancing beyond "visually realistic" generations towards "biologically meaningful" ones.
tldr: This paper introduces CellFluxRL, a reinforcement learning framework that post-trains virtual cell models using biologically meaningful reward functions to enforce physical and biological constraints, moving beyond visually realistic generations to biologically meaningful ones.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了CellFluxRL，一个强化学习框架，它使用具有生物学意义的奖励函数对虚拟细胞模型进行后训练，以强制物理和生物学约束，从而从视觉上逼真的生成转向生物学上具有意义的生成。
summary_zh: 使用生成模型构建虚拟细胞以在计算机中模拟细胞行为，正逐渐成为加速药物发现的一种有前景的范式。然而，先前的基于图像的生成方法可能产生不合理的细胞图像，违反基本的物理和生物学约束。为了解决这个问题，我们提出使用强化学习 (RL) 对虚拟细胞模型进行后训练，利用具有生物学意义的评估器作为奖励函数。我们设计了七个奖励，涵盖三个类别——生物学功能、结构有效性和形态学正确性——并优化最先进的 CellFlux 模型以产生 CellFluxRL。CellFluxRL 在所有奖励方面均始终优于 CellFlux，并且通过测试时缩放进一步提升了性能。总的来说，我们的结果提出了一种虚拟细胞建模框架，该框架通过强化学习强制执行基于物理的约束，从而超越了“视觉上逼真”的生成，并朝着“生物学上有意义”的生成方向发展。

title: Proximal Policy Optimization in Path Space: A Schrödinger Bridge Perspective
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning with generative policies is promising but remains underexplored. A central challenge is that proximal policy optimization (PPO) is traditionally formulated in terms of action-space probability ratios, whereas diffusion- and flow-based policies are more naturally represented as trajectory-level generative processes. In this work, we propose GSB-PPO, a path-space formulation of generative PPO inspired by the Generalized Schrödinger Bridge (GSB). Our framework lifts PPO-style proximal updates from terminal actions to full generation trajectories, yielding a unified view of on-policy optimization for generative policies.
